title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Operations Lead
description:
About PerkUp

PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit perkupapp.com.


We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution.


This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated.


The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction.


This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations.
  • Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy.
  • Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability.
  • Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems; gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix.
  • Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls.
  • Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement.


What success looks like

  • Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably.
  • Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors.
  • Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence.
  • PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement.


What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment.
  • A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator.
  • Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required.
  • Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams.
  • Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output.
  • A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure.
  • Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth.
  • Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking.


Role details

  • Location: Remote, Latin America
  • Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time
  • Engagement: Full-time contractor
  • $4,500–$5,000 USD per month


Growth path

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution.


This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated.


The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction.


This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule.


What you’ll own

  • Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations.
  • Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability.
  • Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy.
  • Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability.
  • Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems; gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix.
  • Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls.
  • Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement.


What success looks like

  • Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably.
  • Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors.
  • Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence.
  • PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement.


What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment.
  • A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator.
  • Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required.
  • Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams.
  • Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output.
  • A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure.
  • Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth.
  • Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking.


Role details

  • Location: Remote, Latin America
  • Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time
  • Engagement: Full-time contractor
  • $4,500–$5,000 USD per month


Growth path

This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability


What you'll need

  • Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm
  • Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English


Nice to have

  • Experience in the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Analista de Governança de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Analista de Governança de Inteligência Artificial


Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!\"



Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Governança de Inteligência Artificial para apoiar a implementação e evolução do framework corporativo de Governança de IA. O profissional ideal deve ser capaz de promover o uso responsável, ético, seguro, transparente e aderente às exigências regulatórias do setor bancário.


Principais atribuições:

• Apoiar a implementação e evolução do framework corporativo de Governança de IA.

• Manter o inventário de ativos de IA, incluindo modelos, agentes, prompts, bases de conhecimento e provedores externos.

• Elaborar e manter taxonomias, políticas, padrões, procedimentos, indicadores e trilhas de auditoria.

• Garantir requisitos de transparência, rastreabilidade, explicabilidade e documentação.

• Apoiar a disseminação da cultura de IA responsável.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos obrigatórios:

• Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou similares.

• Conhecimento em Governança de IA, incluindo inventário de ativos, gestão do ciclo de vida de modelos, classificação de riscos, auditoria, rastreabilidade e accountability.

• Profundos conhecimento de IA, incluindo LLMs, RAG, IA agêntica, embeddings, bancos vetoriais, grounding e guardrails.

• Conhecimento dos principais frameworks e normas de mercado, como NIST AI RMF, EU IA ACT, ISO/IEC 42001 e LGPD.

• Conhecimento em Governança de Dados, incluindo DAMA-DMBOK, gestão de metadados, qualidade de dados, linhagem, Data Stewardship, glossários de negócio, taxonomias, ontologias e gestão semântica.

• Conhecimento em observabilidade, avaliação e monitoramento de soluções de IA, incluindo evals, harnesses de testes, explicabilidade (XAI), Model Cards e Datasheets for Datasets.

• Capacidade de elaborar políticas, padrões, relatórios e documentação técnica.


Requisitos desejáveis:

• Pós-graduação ou certificações em Governança de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Gestão de Riscos ou Segurança da Informação.

• Conhecimento em MLOps, LLMOps, arquiteturas multiagentes, Model Context Protocol (MCP) e agent skills.

• Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo, metadados, observabilidade e governança de IA.

• Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA, incluindo riscos relacionados a prompt injection, data leakage e jailbreak.

• Experiência anterior em ambientes de missão crítica.

• Idioma Inglês avançado para eventuais conversações com fornecedores de solução.

title: Senior AML Investigations & Case Specialist
description:
This role supports the MLRO in fulfilling the company's AML/CFT obligations by conducting local transaction monitoring investigations, screening reviews, case analysis, and suspicious activity assessments. The role is responsible for ensuring that investigative analysis, case documentation, and reporting recommendations are performed and maintained within Brazil in accordance with local regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct investigations into transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions screening hits, and other financial crime cases relating to the Brazilian entity.
  • Analyse customer activity and transaction patterns to identify suspicious activity and document investigative findings.
  • Prepare and maintain complete investigation case files and supporting documentation.
  • Support the MLRO in assessing and recommending suspicious transaction reports to Coaf.
  • Perform local sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening reviews where required.
  • Escalate complex investigations, emerging risks, and material findings to the MLRO.
  • Maintain accurate records of investigations and case decisions for regulatory and audit purposes.
  • Work with global AML teams to obtain supporting intelligence while retaining ownership of the local investigative assessment.
  • Support regulatory examinations, audits, and ongoing enhancement of AML controls and monitoring processes.

Requirements

  • Brazilian citizen with the legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Must be based in Brazil
  • 3–5 years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, financial crime investigations, or compliance within a regulated financial institution, fintech, payment institution, or cryptocurrency exchange.
  • Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, suspicious transaction reporting, and financial crime typologies.
  • Experience with transaction monitoring systems, sanctions screening, and case management tools.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Embraces AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline compliance processes, and enhance the quality of regulatory analysis and decision-making.

Profile

  • Strong analytical and investigative judgement with excellent attention to detail.
  • Able to make sound, risk-based decisions independently while maintaining high standards of documentation.
  • Collaborative, hands-on, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
  • Passionate about cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and the evolving digital asset ecosystem, with a genuine curiosity to stay ahead of industry and regulatory developments.

title: Senior AML Investigations & Case Specialist
description:
This role supports the MLRO in fulfilling the company's AML/CFT obligations by conducting local transaction monitoring investigations, screening reviews, case analysis, and suspicious activity assessments. The role is responsible for ensuring that investigative analysis, case documentation, and reporting recommendations are performed and maintained within Brazil in accordance with local regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct investigations into transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions screening hits, and other financial crime cases relating to the Brazilian entity.
  • Analyse customer activity and transaction patterns to identify suspicious activity and document investigative findings.
  • Prepare and maintain complete investigation case files and supporting documentation.
  • Support the MLRO in assessing and recommending suspicious transaction reports to Coaf.
  • Perform local sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening reviews where required.
  • Escalate complex investigations, emerging risks, and material findings to the MLRO.

  • Work with global AML teams to obtain supporting intelligence while retaining ownership of the local investigative assessment.

title: Sr. Functional Consultant
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Senior Functional Consultant


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Demonstrate thorough knowledge of industry best practices, business processes, o9’s solutions, technical architecture, and value proposition
  • Responsible for solution usability and uptime by resolving any customer issues in a timely fashion, ensuring the accuracy of data loads and validating the e2e workflows
  • Identify any design issues in the existing setup and coordinate with other o9 consultants to solve the business problem. Be the single point of contact for any platform level upgrade/patch/hotfix
  • Configure the o9 platform based on the change requests/enhancements post go-live and deliver them to solve deep operations / supply chain problems
  • Create and execute workflow and data analytics test cases. Work on bugs/issues and track progress at resolving issues using support tool
  • Support Super User and End User training, for a global user base
  • Actively help in improving internal processes and product features based on customer feedback by interfacing with the development and operations teams.


What you’ll have


  • Experience: 2+ years of experience with implementing supply chain demand planning applications.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems or a related field Languages: SQL, MDX, T-SQL or similar; Statistical, Optimization and Simulation skills through software tools and packages like R, SAS, CPLEX or similar is desirable.


Skills:

  • Deep understanding of supply chain planning concepts including Demand Management, Distribution Planning, Master Planning and S&OP.


Characteristics:

  • Strong ability to lead by example and demonstrate proficiency in both product and domain. Patient listener with the ability to clearly articulate your viewpoint to manage and deliver to customer expectations, even under pressure.
  • Ability to analyze and process large amounts of data and complement it with intuition to prioritize and focus on the highest value opportunities or the biggest risks is key.
  • We really value team spirit: Transparency and frequent communication is key. At o9, this is not limited by hierarchy, distance, or function.


What We Offer


  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works


  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment - (If Applicable)
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.



More About Us

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Analista de Gestão de Mudanças Organizacional
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.


Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar e executar estratégias de Gestão da Mudança Organizacional em projetos de transformação.
  • Realizar análises de impacto organizacional, identificando os grupos afetados pelas mudanças.
  • Mapear e gerenciar stakeholders, promovendo o engajamento das áreas envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de comunicação para diferentes públicos.
  • Criar e conduzir ações de capacitação, treinamentos e workshops.
  • Apoiar líderes e gestores na condução das equipes durante processos de mudança.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos relacionados à adoção de novos processos, sistemas ou modelos operacionais.
  • Monitorar indicadores de adesão, engajamento e efetividade das iniciativas de mudança.
  • Aplicar pesquisas de prontidão (readiness), percepção e satisfação dos colaboradores.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e apresentar resultados para liderança e gestão do projeto.
  • Atuar como agente facilitador da transformação organizacional, promovendo a aceitação e sustentabilidade das mudanças.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital, implantação de sistemas, reestruturações organizacionais e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação Completa.
  • Experiência sólida em Gestão de Mudança Organizacional (GMO) atuando em projetos de transformação empresarial de médio e grande porte.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação, transformação ou evolução de ambientes SAP, preferencialmente SAP S/4HANA.
  • Vivência prática e comprovada na condução dos cinco pilares de Gestão de Mudança Organizacional:

* Gestão de Stakeholders;

* Gestão da Comunicação;

* Gestão do Conhecimento e Capacitação;

* Gestão de Impactos Organizacionais;

* Sustentação e Adoção da Mudança.

  • Experiência na elaboração e execução de:

* Análises de Impacto;

* Mapeamento e gestão de stakeholders;

* Estratégias de engajamento;

* Planos de comunicação;

* Planos de treinamento;

* Estratégias de readiness, adoção e sustentação da mudança.

  • Experiência em interação com executivos, sponsors, líderes de negócio, equipes de projeto e usuários finais.
  • Certificação PROSCI Change Management Practitioner (obrigatória).
  • Conhecimento comprovado na aplicação do modelo **ADKAR** em projetos de transformação.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificação **HCMP – Human Change Management Professional.
  • Certificação **HCMBOK Practitioner ou Professional.
  • Experiência em projetos SAP utilizando a metodologia **SAP Activate**.
  • Idioma: Inglês e espanhol nível avançado


Competências:

  • Domínio de metodologias e frameworks de Gestão de Mudança Organizacional.
  • Conhecimento de gestão de projetos e governança de transformação.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver indicadores de adoção, prontidão organizacional e efetividade da mudança.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal, escrita e habilidade de facilitação de workshops.


Regime de Contratação: CLT

Atuação Remota

Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.

*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Engineering Head – Transmission Line Design( US/ Canada)
description:
Role Overview


We are seeking an Engineering Head ( 2 HCs )to serve as the technical authority for E-MAGE in the US market/ Canada

This role is ideal for a Principal Engineer / Engineering Lead from a transmission line design background, capable of leading design, developing local solutions, and representing the company in technical discussions with clients .


Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Leadership (Core)

  • Lead transmission line engineering design (concept, FEED, detailed design)
  • Develop localized solutions based on E-MAGE technologies (CICA, HTMS conductors)
  • Ensure technical feasibility, reliability, and compliance

2. Local Engineering Capability Development

  • Identify, evaluate, and manage US-based engineering design partners
  • Build a reliable and scalable local engineering ecosystem
  • Coordinate internal and external engineering resources across project phases

3. Client-Facing Technical Engagement

  • Represent E-MAGE in technical discussions with utilities, developers, and consultants
  • Clearly communicate complex technical solutions in a value-driven manner
  • Support project acquisition through technical credibility

Qualifications

  • Strong background in transmission line engineering design
  • Experience with NERC / IEEE / NESC standards
  • Ideally licensed as a Professional Engineer (PE) in the US
  • Experience as Engineering Lead / Principal Engineer
  • Strong communication skills with ability to engage clients and stakeholders

title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court / Removal Defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?


If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.


About Bueno Law


Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.


We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.


What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)


  • Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.).
  • Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions.
  • Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation.
  • Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates.
  • Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy.
  • Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.


What We’re Looking For


Hard Skills


  • Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese.
  • 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation).
  • Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills.
  • Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload.
  • Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).


Soft Skills


  • Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments.
  • Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
  • Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused.
  • A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience.
  • Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.


What We Offer


  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Program Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

We are looking for a Program Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


Requirements:

  • Advanced/Fluent English;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
  • Program Management Professional (PgPM) certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years of project management experience managing multiple medium/high complexity projects in a matrix resource environment, working with diverse project sponsors across multiple organizations.
  • 2 to 4 years of experience leading teams.
  • 5+ years of experience in software or systems testing.
  • Experience influencing and managing project teams without formal direct reporting relationships.
  • Experience managing System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) projects using an iterative methodology preferred.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of PMI based project management competency areas and methodologies and experience applying these methods to manage successful projects.
  • Proven leadership in managing multi-company, cross-functional teams and/or projects.
  • Analytical skills are required to effectively manage activities related to budgeting, forecasting, monitoring, process management, risk management, quality control, and reporting.
  • Proven ability and determination to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills and experience, leveraging these skills to interact with all levels of management.
  • Effective interpersonal skills required to develop and maintain system-wide and external relationships.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead large-scale programs from planning through execution and completion.
  • Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, and resources.
  • Monitor program performance, resolve issues, and drive corrective actions.
  • Support vendor selection processes, including RFI/RFP activities.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional and matrixed teams to achieve program objectives.
  • Ensure project milestones, deliverables, and business goals are successfully achieved.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks, dependencies, and issues.
  • Develop contingency plans and provide recommendations to leadership.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders, sponsors, vendors, and business leaders.
  • Drive alignment, prioritization, and decision-making across program initiatives.
  • Oversee program financials, contract management, and vendor performance.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with scope.
  • Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, and change control processes.
  • Track and communicate program metrics, status updates, and lessons learned.
  • Manage resource planning and allocation across multiple projects.
  • Ensure vendor deliverables comply with contractual obligations and statements of work (SOWs).

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance,  it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You’ll Do
  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack , Zoom , and Google Workspace .
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.
What We’re Looking For
  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses
Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.


The Aerial Core Way
  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior | Business Partner
description:
Sobre a oportunidade


Buscamos um(a) Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior | Business Partner para atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, promovendo soluções de gestão de pessoas alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.

Esse profissional terá papel consultivo e de influência junto aos gestores, apoiando decisões relacionadas a desenvolvimento organizacional, atração e retenção de talentos, performance, sucessão e transformação organizacional.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, apoiando decisões relacionadas à gestão de pessoas e estrutura organizacional.
  • Conduzir análises e recomendações sobre movimentações internas, promoções, sucessão, retenção de talentos e desenvolvimento organizacional.
  • Influenciar gestores por meio de dados, indicadores e diagnósticos de pessoas.
  • Liderar processos seletivos para posições estratégicas, técnicas, administrativas e operacionais.
  • Conduzir discussões de desempenho, potencial, desenvolvimento e planejamento sucessório.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar planos de ação voltados a clima organizacional, engajamento e retenção.
  • Monitorar indicadores de RH, identificando tendências, riscos e oportunidades para o negócio.
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas e relatórios gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Liderar projetos relacionados à cultura organizacional, transformação e experiência do colaborador.
  • Garantir a correta aplicação das políticas corporativas de Recursos Humanos.
  • Atuar como interface entre as áreas clientes e os especialistas de RH.
  • Realizar visitas às unidades operacionais sob sua responsabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada como Business Partner ou Analista Generalista de RH Sênior.
  • Vivência em ambientes operacionais e atendimento a múltiplas lideranças.
  • Experiência com indicadores de RH e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Conhecimento dos principais subsistemas de Recursos Humanos.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • CNH categoria B válida.


Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Pessoas, Desenvolvimento Organizacional ou áreas afins.


Competências esperadas

  • Comunicação executiva e capacidade de influência.
  • Visão estratégica e sistêmica.
  • Gestão de conflitos e negociação.
  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Inteligência emocional.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo.
  • Adaptabilidade em ambientes de transformação.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e construção de parcerias.
  • Ética, discrição e confidencialidade.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: International Assistant Recruiter
description:
International Assistant Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiter Assistant with strong English skills to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build an international career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$3,500
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Executive Recruiting, Leadership, Management)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support sourcing and pre-qualification of candidates for U.S. clients
  • Conduct initial screenings via calls, emails, and messages
  • Maintain updated databases (ATS and job boards)
  • Draft and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and candidate–recruiter communication flow
  • Assist with administrative recruitment tasks


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication
  • 3+ months of experience in recruitment
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in Recruitment or Talent Acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Senior FPGA Developer
description:
About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.



About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.



Responsibilities :



  • The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools.
  • This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.


Qualifications :



  • BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps SerDes/transceiver-based FPGA designs.


Required Skills :



  • Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL required.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure).
  • Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10M to 1.6T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs.
  • Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products.
  • Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (VoIP, IPTV).
  • Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques.
  • Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary.
  • Version control experience using Git or similar tools.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world.
  • Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.


Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate
