title: Project Manager
description:
This is a fully remote position, independent contractor (PJ) and salary is 25/hr USD.


Job Capsule:

The Project Manager’s typical area of responsibility includes one or more projects and/or multiple delivery teams across the domain. This includes development, configuration, validation, deployment, and launch of customer solutions, such as PM projects, country or multi-country deployments. Each project may be structured as a series of cumulative Minimum Viable Products (MVPn), with delivery timelines ranging from three months to one year.


This PM will be responsible for the delivery of assigned projects and cross-team initiatives in compliance with the triple constraints of time, budget, and quality. They will challenge Product Owners and platoon/team members on priorities, supports efficient decision-making across teams, and keeps scope aligned with capacity and stakeholder requirements. They will foster an effective working environment by protecting teams from illegitimate influences during sprints and identifying and removing obstacles early.


This PM is the project focal point for stakeholders who are not direct team members and helps ensure clear communication across project teams, PMO, management, and domain stakeholders. When possible, they will also promote the project or related domain initiatives across the organization and externally.


This PM will work closely with the PMO to align processes, reporting standards, and governance practices across the domain. This includes coordinating with multiple teams, ensuring consistent visibility into project status, and tracking cross-team dependencies to support timely decision-making and delivery.


Because typical team members and project stakeholders may be distributed around the world, they must demonstrate strong self-organization, the ability to work effectively across time zones, and the discipline to coordinate multiple teams without overextending themselves while ensuring delivery meets the expected level of quality.


Job Responsibilities

Overall

  • Function as moderator and coach for platoons and project teams. Promote an atmosphere of ownership, trust, and enthusiasm; facilitate alignment within teams and across the broader domain.
  • Onboard new platoon and project team members to Agile and DevOps ways of working.
  • Engage, influence, and collaborate with internal Halliburton Landmark and HDS teams such as R&D, CloudOps, Customer Success, Performance Engineering, and PMO.
  • Partner with PMO to align project management processes, reporting cadence, and governance expectations across the domain
  • Coordinate with multiple teams to maintain clear ownership, communication, and alignment on shared priorities and delivery commitments

Quality management

  • Set the project framework, governance and guidelines
  • Standardize tools when feasible (OpenEarth, AzureDevOps, Teams, Figma, iEnergy, etc.)
  • Provide best practices to platoons and project teams in Agile and DevOps methodologies and processes. In particular, organize, prepare, moderate, and track team ceremonies:
  • Release Planning (MVPn and MVPn+1 to many)
  • Sprint planning, incl. commitment to working agreements
  • Pre-planning
  • Daily Scrum
  • Sprint retrospective, incl. definition of done
  • Create the backlog and assign stories to sprints. Ensure stories match stakeholder expectations
  • Ensure teams follow the Built For Core (B4C) and Back To Community (B2C) governance process.
  • Help liaise with other SmartDigital projects and teams to support rapid knowledge sharing and alignment.

Time management

  • Provide regular updates to management, stakeholders, and PMO. Create standardized reports, including burn-down charts and other metrics relevant for process transparency across teams and the domain.
  • Project and measure team velocity and delivery across assigned teams. Ensure team members remain focused on priorities and are contributing toward shared delivery goals.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Track and manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and follow-ups to ensure blockers are visible and addressed in a timely manner

Cost management

  • Plan and mobilize teams for MVPn and, where applicable, MVPn+1 and other related projects to support capacity planning, bench creation, and resource alignment across the domain.
  • Hire and manage 3rd party vendors where appropriate.
  • Ensure proper budgeting and prioritization process
  • Reports on a regular basis project costs against budget. Realigns resources, budget or expectations to fit.

Requirements

Formal

  • 4 year college degree, preferred in Engineering or Computer Science
  • 2-4 years leading Agile or DevOps teams, preferably certified as Scrum Master. Experience in cloud architecture desired

Informal

  • Excellent technical, coaching and communication skills
  • Leadership without authority, appreciation, empathy and motivational persuasiveness
  • Service minded, structured, will-do attitude
  • Skilled at detecting, understanding and solving problems (organizational and technical)

Bonus

  • Knowledge of Upstream Oil and Gas, Well Construction practice, or Drilling Supervision would bring added value and more fungibility for future roles.

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
VAGA GESTOR DE PROJETOS


Sobre a vaga


Sobre nós:

A Fortraffic Marketing é uma aceleradora de resultados focada em estratégias e tráfego pago, dedicada a impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios de seus clientes através de estratégias de marketing sofisticadas.


Especializados principalmente no mercado de infoprodutos, nosso objetivo final é aumentar significativamente as vendas de nossos clientes, fornecendo soluções eficazes e personalizadas para suas necessidades específicas.


Descrição da vaga:


Você fará parte do time Fortraffic como Gestor de Projetos (Remoto), será responsável por gerenciar os processos de marketing e garantir a execução para nossos clientes. O candidato deve ter sólidos conhecimentos em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Processos/Tarefas e Conhecimentos em Marketing.


Responsabilidades:


  • Planejar e Gerenciar projetos;
  • Construir planejamento de projetos em conjunto com a equipe;
  • Construir fluxos e processos entre as áreas;
  • Realizar planejamento e gestão de projetos;
  • Liderar estimativas de prazo de projetos;
  • Controlar prazos e entregáveis dos projetos;
  • Participar de reuniões dos projetos;
  • Fazer a interface entre as equipes;
  • Reunir-se com os demais membros do time (Reuniões Diárias);
  • Definir as tarefas para execução de cada projeto;

description:
Arquiteto(a) de Dados | Microsoft Fabric | Inglês Fluente


A UPBI está em busca de Arquiteto(a) de Dados – Microsoft Fabric para atuar em um projeto internacional, com foco no desenho e implementação de arquiteturas modernas de dados no ecossistema Microsoft Fabric.


Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em arquitetura de dados, capaz de atuar na definição de boas práticas, governança, segurança e construção de soluções utilizando Microsoft Fabric.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e definir arquiteturas de dados utilizando Microsoft Fabric ;
  • Desenvolver soluções para ingestão de dados provenientes de fontes SAP e não-SAP ;

  • Configurar e gerenciar CI/CD Deployment Pipelines ;
  • Desenvolver relatórios complexos em Power BI .

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de dados utilizando Microsoft Fabric ;

Descrição da vaga

Seu próximo desafio está aqui!

Na Webmotors, não buscamos apenas talentos — buscamos pessoas que queiram acelerar junto com a gente , impulsionadas pela escolha de ir além e pavimentar o caminho do sucesso.

Somos a principal plataforma digital do segmento automotivo no Brasil, transformando a experiência de compra e venda de veículos por meio da tecnologia, inovação e de um time apaixonado por causar impacto real .


Se você é um(a) analista inquieto(a), criativo(a) e movido(a) por propósito; se ama ambientes colaborativos, valoriza a autonomia com direção , gosta de desafios que impulsionam o crescimento e quer construir o futuro em um time que está dirigindo o setor automotivo — seu lugar é aqui!

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de acelerar ideias, desviar de obstáculos com leveza e manter o olhar lá na frente , sempre buscando ser um pouco melhor a cada dia. Valorizamos e impulsionamos cada talento, oferecendo um ambiente seguro e inclusivo, onde o crescimento profissional e pessoal são prioridades.


Somos CAR Group. Somos Santander. Somos Webmotors! E estamos prontos para pilotar essa transformação com você.


Vem com a gente fazer parte de algo grandioso!

#SejaParteImportanteDeAlgoGrandioso #BeABigPartOfSomethingBig

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Gestão e prospecção de clientes em uma área geográfica pré definida, com foco na carteira de Clientes (Centro Oeste do Brasil)
  • Responsável pela oferta de produtos e capacitações da carteira de Clientes para maior performance de utilização.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time comercial, bem como suporte para venda de produtos.
  • Realização de eventos para oferta de produtos, organizando eventos presenciais ou remotos diretamente aos clientes.
  • Ser capaz de construir de planos de ação para implementação da estratégia, sempre em sinergia com time comercial.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Superior completo ou cursando.
  • Desejável conhecimento básico em Marketing Digital, tais como: Mídia Display, Redes Sociais e Search, bem como seus KPIs (CPM, CTR, CPV, CPC, CPL).
  • Power Point Intermediário.
  • Excel Intermediário.
  • Capacidade de Influência.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva (oral e escrita).
  • Veículo próprio para realizar as visitas (carro).
  • Capacidade de multiplicar conhecimento e informações, além de capacitar clientes internos e externos para correta utilização dos produtos.


Informações adicionais

Acreditamos que a verdadeira transformação só acontece quando diferentes histórias, olhares e trajetórias se encontram. Por isso, valorizamos e promovemos um ambiente diverso, seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam ser quem são — com autonomia, respeito e pertencimento.


Nosso modelo de trabalho é presencial , na Vila Olímpia . Um espaço colaborativo, moderno e cheio de conexões — onde ideias ganham velocidade e pessoas impulsionam o futuro.


Benefícios que fazem a jornada valer a pena 🚗

Na Webmotors, acreditamos que cuidar das nossas pessoas é o primeiro passo para acelerar grandes transformações. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar sua saúde, bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida — dentro e fora do trabalho.

title: Performance Media Buyer
description:
We are currently looking for a hands-on and results-driven Performance Media Buyer to join our team in a remote, full-time position. This role is built for professionals who will directly hold, manage, and scale ad accounts across major digital advertising networks to drive profitable customer acquisition.

If you are comfortable managing direct ad spend, optimizing live budgets, and taking full ownership of campaign performance, we want to talk to you.


Key Responsibilities


Directly manage, structure, and scale high-budget advertising accounts across performance channels (Meta, Google, or TikTok).


Monitor live ad accounts daily, making real-time adjustments to budgets, bids, targeting, and scaling architectures.


Analyze campaign data closely to track core financial and performance metrics (ROAS, CPA, CTR, Hook Rate, CAC).


Collaborate with creative teams to test new ad iterations and ensure winning concepts are scaled immediately within the ad accounts.


Maintain account health, monitor compliance policies, and handle tracking setups (Pixels, CAPI, GA4).


Requirements


Proven hands-on experience directly managing and scaling performance ad accounts with substantial monthly budgets.


Deep technical familiarity with ad managers, backend account settings, tracking configurations, and pixel integrations.


Strong analytical mindset focused heavily on return on ad spend (ROAS) and unit economics rather than surface-level metrics.


Independent, disciplined work ethic capable of solving account-level bottlenecks quickly in a remote setting.


What We Offer


Compensation: $5,500 – $6,700 USD per month, plus performance incentives tied directly to your results.


Remote full-time working environment.


Opportunity to handle and scale substantial ad budgets with high growth impact.


Professional development and leadership growth opportunities.


  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.

title: Analista Comercial Junior | Marketing de Influência
description:
Estamos buscando uma pessoa para integrar o time da RARA como Analista Comercial Junior , em formato remoto e período integral.


O profissional será responsável pela prospecção e gestão comercial do casting da RARA , atuando como principal ponto de contato entre creators, marcas e a agência. Buscamos alguém com olhar estratégico para identificar oportunidades, construir boas relações e transformar conexões em parcerias relevantes para os talentos representados.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar creators alinhados ao posicionamento da RARA;
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento comercial para cada creator;
  • Prospectar campanhas e construir relacionamento com marcas e agências;
  • Negociar ações comerciais, campanhas e parcerias para os creators do casting;
  • Acompanhar oportunidades e processos comerciais, garantindo uma boa comunicação entre creators, marcas e agência.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia com creators, marketing de influência e/ou mercado publicitário;
  • Perfil comercial, boa comunicação e habilidade de negociação;
  • Organização e boa gestão de processos;
  • Proatividade e facilidade para construir relacionamentos;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em período integral.


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto.

Contrato: PJ.

title: Product Designer
description:
En ACL , empresa líder en soluciones tecnológicas con más de 30 años de experiencia en Latinoamérica, estamos buscando Product Designer .


Modalidad: 100% remoto- Residentes en Brasil

Contratación inicial por 6 meses, con posibilidad de extensión.


Qué harás?

  • Diseñar soluciones centradas en el usuario, liderando el proceso de diseño de principio a fin: discovery, definición, diseño, validación con usuarios, experimentación y evolución del producto.
  • Colaborar con Product, Desarrollo y otros stakeholders para construir soluciones escalables, alineadas con los objetivos del negocio y la factibilidad técnica.
  • Validar hipótesis mediante investigación, análisis de datos y medición de resultados, promoviendo la mejora continua y la toma de decisiones basada en evidencia.


Qué buscamos?

  • Formación en Diseño, UX, Comunicación, Psicología, Periodismo, Publicidad o carreras afines.
  • Al menos 5 años de experiencia en roles de UX/Product Design.
  • Conocimientos en: Figma, Design Systems, Diseño de Interfaces, Arquitectura de Información, Metodologías Ágiles, OKRs, Product Mindset, Data Analytics, conceptos generales de IA y experimentación (A/B Testing).
  • Experiencia en productos digitales de alta escala, investigación de usuarios, análisis de datos, métricas de producto y negocio, diseño accesible (WCAG), validación con usuarios y trabajo con equipos multidisciplinarios.
  • Manejo de español y portugués (excluyente).


Beneficios que te esperan

  • Modalidad de trabajo remoto
  • Asignaciones monetarias
  • Cursos gratis en ACL Academy
  • Días libres pagos
  • Desarrollo profesional
  • Bonificación por referidos
  • Cultura organizacional cercana, inclusiva y orientada al bienestar


Nuestra cultura

En ACL, transformamos desafíos en oportunidades. Con más de 30 años apoyando a empresas en Chile y LATAM, combinamos experiencia, innovación y tecnología para entregar soluciones a medida en Desarrollo de Software, QA, IA y Staff Augmentation. Más que un proveedor, somos un socio estratégico que entiende las necesidades de cada cliente y trabaja a su lado para alcanzar objetivos. Para nuestro Team Aceliano, somos un espacio de aprendizaje, crecimiento y realización profesional.


¿Te interesa?

Envía tu CV actualizado a indicando en el asunto: Product Designer - ACL .

¡Estamos listos para conocerte!


* Trabajamos bajo la Ley 21.015 de inclusión de personas con discapacidad. Todas las personas están invitadas a participar.

title: GTM Education & Community Manager
description:
We're hiring someone who walks into a room of founders and owns it by minute two.


R$14,700 to R$20,600 Monthly | Brazil, remote (Rio de Janeiro preferred) | Unlimited PTO


The role

You inherit a training program and a community that already work, and you are handed full ownership of both. From there it is yours: what gets taught and to whom, how the community runs, where the whole thing goes next. You teach live every week to founders betting their company on Microsoft Marketplace, and you own the number that says it landed. A real program to run and grow, not a blank page and not somebody else's to approve.


You'll join a marketing team of four (designer, growth marketer, content marketer), report to the Head of Marketing, and work daily with Customer Success, Account Managers, and Partnerships.


Who we're looking for

Someone who loves to teach and misses it when they stop. You can hold a room of CEOs, marketing and sales directors in English, and take a hard question without losing the thread. You come from B2B sales, marketing, or startups, so the room recognizes you as one of them.


What you'll own


1. The program

  • The curriculum plan: what gets taught, in what order, to whom
  • Live delivery, on camera, weekly
  • Learning design: objectives, exercises, assessment, not slides
  • The metric that proves it worked, and the rewrite when it didn't

2. The community

  • Programming calendar, member journey, moderation standard
  • Engaged participation as the number, not signups
  • Members turned into content contributors
  • Recurring interviews with our CEO, partners, and customers


What you bring

  • 3-5 years teaching or running education programs. B2B SaaS strongly preferred
  • End-to-end ownership of a training program, not delivery only
  • Live teaching to a business audience
  • Community building: a peer network, user group, or alumni cohort
  • Hands-on with GTM tooling, enough to teach while using it
  • AI in your daily workflow, with the judgment to review it. Raw AI output doesn't ship here


Nice to have

  • Microsoft partner, cloud marketplace, or co-sell motion
  • GTM tools: Clay, Apollo, Lemlist
  • Instructional design or adult learning
  • LMS and community platforms: Circle, Teachable, Skilljar
  • Portuguese, French, or Spanish fluency


Details

  • R$14,700 to R$20,600 per month, plus an end-of-year bonus
  • Two recordings of trainings you have delivered in English, requested with your application
  • Professional English (only English CVs will be considered)


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

We're hiring someone who walks into a room of founders and owns it by minute two.


R$14,700 to R$20,600 Monthly | Brazil, remote (Rio de Janeiro preferred) | Unlimited PTO


The role

You inherit a training program and a community that already work, and you are handed full ownership of both. From there it is yours: what gets taught and to whom, how the community runs, where the whole thing goes next. You teach live every week to founders betting their company on Microsoft Marketplace, and you own the number that says it landed. A real program to run and grow, not a blank page and not somebody else's to approve.


You'll join a marketing team of four (designer, growth marketer, content marketer), report to the Head of Marketing, and work daily with Customer Success, Account Managers, and Partnerships.


Who we're looking for

Someone who loves to teach and misses it when they stop. You can hold a room of CEOs, marketing and sales directors in English, and take a hard question without losing the thread. You come from B2B sales, marketing, or startups, so the room recognizes you as one of them.


What you'll own


1. The program

  • The curriculum plan: what gets taught, in what order, to whom
  • Live delivery, on camera, weekly
  • Learning design: objectives, exercises, assessment, not slides
  • The metric that proves it worked, and the rewrite when it didn't

2. The community

  • Programming calendar, member journey, moderation standard
  • Engaged participation as the number, not signups
  • Members turned into content contributors
  • Recurring interviews with our CEO, partners, and customers


What you bring

  • 3-5 years teaching or running education programs. B2B SaaS strongly preferred
  • End-to-end ownership of a training program, not delivery only
  • Live teaching to a business audience
  • Community building: a peer network, user group, or alumni cohort
  • Hands-on with GTM tooling, enough to teach while using it
  • AI in your daily workflow, with the judgment to review it. Raw AI output doesn't ship here


Nice to have

  • Microsoft partner, cloud marketplace, or co-sell motion
  • GTM tools: Clay, Apollo, Lemlist
  • Instructional design or adult learning
  • LMS and community platforms: Circle, Teachable, Skilljar
  • Portuguese, French, or Spanish fluency


Details

  • R$14,700 to R$20,600 per month, plus an end-of-year bonus
  • Two recordings of trainings you have delivered in English, requested with your application
  • Professional English (only English CVs will be considered)


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

title: Analista de Gestão de Vulnerabilidades Jr
description:
A Blaze Information Security está contratando Analista de Gestão de Vulnerabilidades Júnior no Brasil.

Somos uma empresa de consultoria em cibersegurança sediada em Berlim, Alemanha, com escritórios no Recife, Brasil, e Porto, Portugal.


Fundada em 2016, nosso portfólio inclui clientes na América do Norte, Europa e América do Sul.

Acreditamos firmemente na excelência técnica e possuímos uma vasta experiência na entrega de projetos complexos para clientes em diversos setores.


Estamos à procura de uma pessoa em início de carreira para integrar nossa equipe de segurança e atuar diretamente em atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, apoiando nossos clientes na identificação, análise, priorização e acompanhamento da correção de vulnerabilidades em seus ambientes.

Você trabalhará ao lado de profissionais experientes em segurança ofensiva e defensiva, tendo contato com diferentes tecnologias, ambientes e desafios de segurança.


Todas as vagas oferecidas pela Blaze Information Security são para o formato remoto ou híbrido. Para esta posição, temos preferência pelo regime de contratação PJ.


Responsabilidades gerais:

  • Analisar, classificar e priorizar vulnerabilidades identificadas em ambientes de clientes
  • Apoiar a execução de scans e a validação de vulnerabilidades e falsos positivos
  • Acompanhar o processo de remediação junto às equipes técnicas dos clientes
  • Manter tickets, dashboards e relatórios de vulnerabilidades atualizados
  • Pesquisar CVEs, advisories, exploits e recomendações de correção
  • Participar de reuniões internas e com clientes


Requisitos do profissional júnior:

  • Conhecimentos básicos de segurança da informação e gestão de vulnerabilidades
  • Familiaridade com CVE, CVSS, OWASP Top 10, redes, Linux e Windows
  • Capacidade de pesquisar e compreender vulnerabilidades e recomendações técnicas
  • Boa organização, capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes
  • Boa comunicação em português e inglês para leitura de documentação técnica
  • Interesse em desenvolver carreira em segurança da informação


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Nessus, Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, OpenVAS ou ferramentas similares
  • Conhecimento básico de AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud
  • Familiaridade com Jira, ServiceNow ou ferramentas de gestão de tickets
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Python, Bash ou PowerShell
  • Graduação ou formação em andamento em tecnologia ou segurança da informação
  • Participação em CTFs, laboratórios, projetos pessoais ou comunidades de segurança


Faixa de remuneração:

  • R$ 3.800 a R$ 5.200 mensais
  • Contratação em regime PJ


Local de trabalho:

  • 100% remoto
  • Vaga aberta para profissionais residentes no Brasil


Os interessados deverão enviar seus currículos no formato PDF para , com o assunto \"Candidatura Analista de Gestão de Vulnerabilidades Júnior - Brasil\" .

title: Consultor de Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)
description:
Consultor(a) de Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)


Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) para desenhar e operar jornadas omnichannel em tempo real em projetos enterprise no ecossistema Adobe Experience Cloud. É um papel para quem vem da orquestração de CRM e campaign, já operou o AJO em ambiente produtivo e agora quer atuar como consultor de martech junto a grandes marcas.


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Contrato CLT + benefícios


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS:

1. Orquestração de jornadas omnichannel

- Desenhar, configurar e operar jornadas no AJO nos canais de e-mail, SMS, push, web push, in-app e WhatsApp.

- Combinar disparo em tempo real (eventos) com disparo em batch (audiências).

- Construir as jornadas com o journey designer, condições, esperas e ações.


2. Dados e audiências

- Criar e ativar audiências a partir de perfis unificados do Adobe Experience Platform e do Real-Time CDP.

- Trabalhar com schemas XDM e datasets de perfil e evento.

- Traduzir lógica de negócio e de CRM em configuração de jornada (regras de entrada, divisões de decisão, conteúdo personalizado em tempo real).


3. Deliverability e provisionamento de canal

- Provisionar canais, IPs dedicados e domínios de envio, com plano de IP warming.

- Configurar SPF, DKIM e DMARC, e monitorar reputação, bounce e spam.

- Integrar provedores de SMS e o Mobile SDK para push.


4. Decisioning e personalização

- Configurar regras de decisão e conteúdo personalizado nas jornadas.

- Quando o projeto usa Offer Decisioning, trabalhar a offer library, o motor de decisão, ranking e capping para entregar a oferta certa no canal certo.


5. QA, monitoramento e otimização

- Testar e validar jornadas antes do launch.

- Monitorar a execução e reportar KPIs (open rate, CTR, conversão por canal, engajamento).

Otimizar com base em performance, aproveitando os recursos de IA e ML do próprio AJO no decisioning e na otimização, como ranking de ofertas e send-time optimization.


REQUISITOS:

Plataforma AJO

Experiência operando o AJO em produção, em implementação e operação de campanhas, vinda de uma base de CRM e campaign orchestration (Adobe Campaign, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, SAS ou equivalente). Certificação isolada não substitui experiência de produção.


Base de dados Adobe:

- Conhecimento da arquitetura do Adobe Experience Platform: schemas XDM, datasets, identidade e perfil unificado.

- Real-Time CDP: segmentação e ativação de audiências.


Consultoria e relacionamento:

- Perfil client-facing, com comunicação clara com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

- Autonomia, atenção a detalhe e capacidade de traduzir necessidade de negócio em solução técnica.


Idiomas

Inglês intermediário para avançado, para leitura de documentação técnica e interlocução com parceiros internacionais (terá entrevista em inglês)


Conformidade:

- Conhecimento de LGPD e gestão de consentimento (opt-in/opt-out, controle de saturação de comunicação).


DIFERENCIAIS:

Offer Decisioning (offer library, motor de decisão, regras de elegibilidade, ranking e capping), com pontos extras para decisioning avançado, como o code-based experience channel e modelos de ranking por IA. Diferencia fortemente.

- Customer Journey Analytics (CJA).

- Experiência em migração de plataformas legadas (Responsys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SAS) para o AJO.

- Certificação Adobe Journey Optimizer ou Adobe Experience Platform.

- Mobile SDK, Web SDK e Adobe Launch (Tags).

- Vivência em verticais de alta escala: loyalty, aviação, serviços financeiros ou varejo.

- HTML e CSS para templates de e-mail, e integrações via API REST.

1. Orquestração de jornadas omnichannel

- Desenhar, configurar e operar jornadas no AJO nos canais de e-mail, SMS, push, web push, in-app e WhatsApp.

- Combinar disparo em tempo real (eventos) com disparo em batch (audiências).

- Construir as jornadas com o journey designer, condições, esperas e ações.


2. Dados e audiências

- Criar e ativar audiências a partir de perfis unificados do Adobe Experience Platform e do Real-Time CDP.

- Trabalhar com schemas XDM e datasets de perfil e evento.

- Traduzir lógica de negócio e de CRM em configuração de jornada (regras de entrada, divisões de decisão, conteúdo personalizado em tempo real).


3. Deliverability e provisionamento de canal

- Provisionar canais, IPs dedicados e domínios de envio, com plano de IP warming.

- Configurar SPF, DKIM e DMARC, e monitorar reputação, bounce e spam.

- Integrar provedores de SMS e o Mobile SDK para push.


4. Decisioning e personalização

- Configurar regras de decisão e conteúdo personalizado nas jornadas.

- Quando o projeto usa Offer Decisioning, trabalhar a offer library, o motor de decisão, ranking e capping para entregar a oferta certa no canal certo.


5. QA, monitoramento e otimização

- Testar e validar jornadas antes do launch.

- Monitorar a execução e reportar KPIs (open rate, CTR, conversão por canal, engajamento).

Otimizar com base em performance, aproveitando os recursos de IA e ML do próprio AJO no decisioning e na otimização, como ranking de ofertas e send-time optimization.


REQUISITOS:

Plataforma AJO

Experiência operando o AJO em produção, em implementação e operação de campanhas, vinda de uma base de CRM e campaign orchestration (Adobe Campaign, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, SAS ou equivalente). Certificação isolada não substitui experiência de produção.


Base de dados Adobe:

- Conhecimento da arquitetura do Adobe Experience Platform: schemas XDM, datasets, identidade e perfil unificado.

- Real-Time CDP: segmentação e ativação de audiências.


Consultoria e relacionamento:

- Perfil client-facing, com comunicação clara com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

- Autonomia, atenção a detalhe e capacidade de traduzir necessidade de negócio em solução técnica.


Idiomas

Inglês intermediário para avançado, para leitura de documentação técnica e interlocução com parceiros internacionais (terá entrevista em inglês)


Conformidade:

- Conhecimento de LGPD e gestão de consentimento (opt-in/opt-out, controle de saturação de comunicação).


DIFERENCIAIS:

Offer Decisioning (offer library, motor de decisão, regras de elegibilidade, ranking e capping), com pontos extras para decisioning avançado, como o code-based experience channel e modelos de ranking por IA. Diferencia fortemente.

- Customer Journey Analytics (CJA).

- Experiência em migração de plataformas legadas (Responsys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SAS) para o AJO.

- Certificação Adobe Journey Optimizer ou Adobe Experience Platform.

- Mobile SDK, Web SDK e Adobe Launch (Tags).

- Vivência em verticais de alta escala: loyalty, aviação, serviços financeiros ou varejo.

- HTML e CSS para templates de e-mail, e integrações via API REST.

title: Global Payroll & Compensation Specialist
description:
TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, Carnegie, Flywire, YipitData, Niche, and BellXcel.

We are looking for a skilled Global Payroll and Compensation Manager to join our Finance team and take ownership of global payroll and compensation operations for employees and contractors.

This role is critical to ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll execution while supporting the company’s financial operations in a fully remote, international environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end global payroll processes for employees and contractors as part of the Finance function
  • Ensure accurate calculation and timely payment of salaries, bonuses, reimbursements, and other compensation components
  • Review and validate time-tracking data prior to payroll processing
  • Coordinate, review, and approve benefits-related requests in collaboration with HR and external providers
  • Process payroll-related payments via banks and international payment systems
  • Partner with EOR providers to manage payroll operations across multiple countries
  • Act as a key Finance team contact for payroll and compensation-related inquiries
  • Ensure payroll data accuracy, proper documentation, and confidentiality
  • Support financial reporting by providing payroll-related data and reconciliations
  • Collaborate closely with Legal, HR, and external partners to improve payroll and compensation processes


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in payroll, compensation, or finance-related roles
  • Proven experience managing payroll for employees and contractors
  • Solid understanding of payroll processes within a Finance function
  • Experience working with banks and international payment systems
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Good command of English (written and spoken)


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with EOR (Employer of Record) services
  • Background in EOR and recruitment services
  • Experience using QuickBooks
  • Experience supporting payroll in global, remote-first companies


What We Offer

  • Full-time remote role with flexible working arrangements
  • Opportunity to work in a global, fast-growing environment
  • Collaboration with international teams and partners
  • Competitive compensation package

title: ANALISTA DE SAC 2.0
description:
Vaga — Analista de SAC 2.0


Regime: PJ

Modelo de trabalho: híbrido (Belém)


O Grupo Phocus — ecossistema de comunicação criativo e em constante expansão — está em busca de um(a) ANALISTA DE SAC 2.0, na cidade de Belém , para atuar de forma estratégica na construção, integração e acompanhamento das campanhas e projetos dos nossos clientes. 

Buscamos alguém para ficar responsável por gerenciar a interação entre a marca e o público nas redes sociais. É um elo essencial na construção da percepção da marca no ambiente digital. Com atuação estratégica, vai além do simples atendimento, garantindo a saudabilidade da marca, gerenciando crises e fornecendo insights valiosos. Assegura uma comunicação ágil, humanizada e alinhada com os objetivos do cliente e traz, em tempo real, informações e percepções do público que ajudam na criação de estratégias assertivas de comunicação.


Responsabilidades Principais


Configurações - SAC 2.0

  * Manter configuradas e ativas as plataformas de SAC 2.0 (Buzzmonitor);

  * Definir, cadastrar e organizar as tags de cada cliente/conta;

  * Ampliar as tags para cobrir insights específicos das campanhas e áreas críticas, sempre que necessário.


Monitoramento e Interação - SAC 2.0

  * Identificar corretamente os sentimentos (positivo, negativo, neutro) das mensagens;

  * Responder comentários em tempo real, com linguagem clara e empática, alinhada ao tom de voz da marca;

  * Criar respostas padronizadas (FAQ) para dúvidas frequentes, ajustando conforme a evolução dos temas;

  * Gerenciar crises, implementando protocolos para resposta rápidas, alinhando-se ao cliente e ao time interno.


Análise de Dados de Social Listening

  • Mapear tendências e temas recorrentes: antecipar possíveis crises e sugerir melhorias;

  * Acompanhar a saudabilidade da marca, através de métricas e relatórios comparativos sobre a percepção da marca no ambiente digital;

  * Colaborar com o time de planejamento, fornecendo insights sobre comportamento e preferências do público para ajustes em estratégias de conteúdo e mídia;

  * Mapear oportunidades de engajamento que ampliem o alcance orgânico.


Relatórios

  * Coletar dados para a elaboração de relatórios de desempenho e análise de métricas;

  * Organizar os dados coletados corretamente, em planilhas e/ou dashboards;

  * Montar relatórios eguindo o padrão e apresentar resultados de maneira compreensível.


Requisitos

* Experiência com plataformas de monitoramento (Buzzmonitor ou similares);

* Habilidade em atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente em ambientes digitais;

* Conhecimento básico de métricas de redes sociais e relatórios analíticos;

* Familiaridade com gestão de crises no ambiente digital;

* Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel);

* Conhecimento em ferramentas de apresentação (Apresentações Google, PPT).


Diferencial: Utilização de IA para tornar os processos mais assertivos e ágeis.


Habilidades


SOFT SKILLS

Comunicação eficaz

Empatia

Resolução de problemas

Trabalho sob pressão

Atenção aos detalhes

Organização e gestão do tempo

Trabalho em equipe e colaboração


HARD SKILLS

Domínio de ferramentas de monitoramento e SAC (Buzzmonitor)

Escrita profissional, com adaptação de tom de voz.

Conhecimento básico em gestão de crise.

Familiaridade com métricas de redes sociais.

Coleta, organização e análise de dados.

Criação e análise de relatórios de social listening.

Excel básico.

Cargo de representante de desenvolvimento de negócios na Poliverso a pessoa será responsável por prospectar novas oportunidades comerciais e apoiar o crescimento da base de clientes.   • Experiência em inside sales e vendas consultivas com capacidade de conduzir conversas estruturadas e avançar oportunidades ao longo do funil comercial.


  • Habilidade em lead generation incluindo pesquisa de mercado, qualificação de contatos e uso de ferramentas para identificação de novos prospects.


  • Competências sólidas de comunicação oral e escrita com capacidade de adaptar a mensagem a diferentes públicos e construir relacionamentos de confiança.


  • Conhecimento em sales e business development com foco em atingir metas analisar resultados para propor melhorias de estratégia comercial.

title: Customer Support Manager
description:
If helping people is just what you do — read on.

Some people help because it’s their job. You help because you can’t not. When a friend’s Wi-Fi breaks, you’re the one on the phone with them for an hour, and you actually enjoy it. That’s who we’re looking for.


About Trakyo

Trakyo is an all-in-one tracking platform. We show businesses exactly where their revenue comes from — every step of the funnel, no guesswork. Our customers love us because we treat their business like our own. That starts with you.


What you’ll do

You’ll be the person our customers talk to. That means:

  • Answering questions and solving problems via Intercom, WhatsApp, Slack, and video calls
  • Walking customers through onboarding and tracking setup, and making the technical stuff feel easy
  • Troubleshooting issues, verifying setups, and not letting go until things actually work
  • Spotting patterns in feedback and passing ideas to the product and engineering team
  • Confirming bugs, writing clear tickets, and helping test fixes


Who you are

Culture comes first here. Skills can be taught — caring can’t.

  • You genuinely love helping people. Solving someone’s problem makes your day.
  • You’re warm, patient, and positive — even on the tenth “it’s not working” of the day
  • You’re tech-curious: you like figuring out how things work, and you learn fast on your own
  • You’re organized and reliable — people can count on you


What you’ll need

  • Near-native English (spoken and written)
  • Availability during US Eastern hours and a stable internet connection
  • A basic feel for sales funnels and customer journeys
  • Basic knowledge of the tools sales teams use — forms, schedulers, landing page builders
  • Comfort with the technical side of support:

- Browser dev tools (Console + Network tab) for basic troubleshooting

- How cookies, sessions, ad-blockers, and privacy features affect tracking

- DNS basics — A/CNAME records, nameservers, Cloudflare

- Basic web/script implementation and debugging API, webhook, or automation issues (Zapier, Make, n8n)

- Experience with tracking platforms, ad pixels, or website builders is a plus — but attitude beats résumé every time.


Why join

You’ll be early at a growing product, working directly with the founders. Your ideas will shape how we support customers and what we build next. And you’ll spend your days doing the thing you love: helping people win.


Compensation

$1,500 – $3,000 USD/month USD, paid as a full-time contractor. Final offer depends on experience.


Interested?

title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)
description:
Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)

Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Reports To: CRO / Founder

Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)


We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities.

  • In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations:

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize).
  • Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations.
  • Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office).

2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR):

  • Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners.
  • Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable.
  • Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese.

3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements:

  • Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors.
  • Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports.
  • Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure).

4. Data Integrity & Reporting:

  • Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity.
  • Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices.
  • Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies).
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (QuickBooks, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote working environment with flexibility.
  • Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Social Media & Content


Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About the Client


Our client is a marketing and creative agency that helps brands grow through a combination of digital marketing, social media, content creation, video production, paid media, and creative design .

The agency works with brands across different industries, developing engaging, social-first content designed to build audiences, increase brand visibility, and support business growth.

The team is currently expanding its video production capabilities to support a new college-focused social app . The project will involve creating authentic, engaging short-form content featuring college campuses, student conversations, street interviews, and promotional material.


About the Role


We are looking for a Short-Form Video Editor to join the creative team and support the launch of a new social app designed for college students.

The primary focus of this role will be editing short-form social media content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

You will work with raw footage, often recorded on phones or other lightweight equipment, and turn it into polished, engaging content that feels natural to a young U.S. audience.

A strong understanding of social media culture, Gen Z content, pacing, storytelling, and current short-form video trends is important for this role.

Candidates with previous experience editing street interviews, man-on-the-street content, campus videos, interviews, UGC, or youth-oriented social content are especially encouraged to apply.


Key Responsibilities


  • Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.
  • Turn raw phone-shot and camera footage into polished, engaging social content.
  • Edit college campus tours, street interviews, student conversations, promotional videos, and UGC-style content.
  • Review large amounts of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, reactions, quotes, and answers.
  • Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.
  • Build a clear and engaging story from multiple clips.
  • Use jump cuts, hard cuts, B-roll, and pacing to maintain viewer attention.
  • Cut footage to music and beats when appropriate.
  • Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, and other social-first elements.
  • Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, pacing, and editing style across content.
  • Repurpose footage into multiple short-form pieces when appropriate.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently.
  • Manage a high volume of content during the app's launch period.
  • Potentially support video projects for other agency clients as the role develops.


Requirements


  • Proven experience editing short-form social media content .
  • Strong proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable Adobe video-editing software.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual rhythm.
  • Ability to turn raw footage into engaging short-form content.
  • Experience with basic color correction and audio editing.
  • Ability to work effectively with phone-shot, raw, and imperfect footage.
  • Good understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other short-form formats.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while taking direction and incorporating feedback.
  • Strong English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Previous experience editing street interviews or man-on-the-street videos .
  • Experience with college, campus, student, Gen Z, lifestyle, dating, social, or UGC content.
  • Experience editing interviews and multi-person conversations.
  • Experience working with high-volume social media content.
  • Familiarity with Adobe After Effects .
  • Basic motion graphics and animation skills.
  • Experience creating engaging captions and animated text.
  • Strong awareness of current TikTok and Instagram editing trends.


The ideal candidate knows how to:


  • Start with a strong hook.
  • Remove unnecessary pauses, filler, and dead space.
  • Keep conversations moving with natural cuts and jump cuts.
  • Identify the funniest, most interesting, surprising, or relatable moments.
  • Combine multiple interview responses into a cohesive story.
  • Use B-roll strategically.
  • Add clean, readable captions.
  • Use music and sound effects when they enhance the content.
  • Keep the content authentic and conversational.
  • Avoid excessive transitions, effects, and animations when they don't add value.

title: Bilingual Account Executive
description:
MasterPro is a US Home Services company operating across California and Oregon, with expansion underway into Washington, Texas, and Louisiana. We're an authorized installation provider for major national retailers.


We're hiring one Account Executive to own some accounts and bring more — managing existing relationships and building the book from there.


What you'll do


  • Own assigned accounts as the single point of contact
  • Daily outbound calling to prospects and existing clients
  • Run virtual meetings and build presentations
  • Develop account growth plans and close new business
  • Follow every project start to finish — verify photos, documentation, and completion
  • Coordinate in-person team meetings when needed
  • Own your revenue targets


Requirements


  • 4+ years in B2B sales, with direct experience selling to US clients
  • Native or fluent English — you'll be on calls with American clients daily
  • Proven record of hitting revenue targets
  • Comfortable with CRM tools and video conferencing
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, own computer


Nice to have


  • Home services, construction, or trades background
  • Experience with Monday.com


Details


  • Fully remote
  • Base compensation plus uncapped commission
  • Training provided
  • To apply, send your resume and a short note on your US sales experience to with the subject line \"Account Executive\"

title: Analista de SAC — Remoto
description:
A Jungle Gaming cria jogos originais e tecnologia para operações globais de iGaming. Estamos contratando Analista de SAC para oferecer suporte claro, ágil e cuidadoso e transformar cada contato em informação útil para a operação e o produto.


Você atenderá jogadores por chat ao vivo, e-mail e redes sociais. O trabalho combina comunicação, investigação de problemas, encaminhamento responsável de casos e organização de feedback para melhorar tanto o atendimento quanto a experiência no produto.


Como será o sucesso na função


Os jogadores recebem orientações corretas e entendem quais são os próximos passos. Dúvidas são resolvidas com cuidado, casos que exigem outras áreas chegam às pessoas responsáveis com contexto suficiente e padrões recorrentes ficam visíveis cedo. Os registros permitem acompanhar cada atendimento e ajudam Produto e Desenvolvimento a corrigir problemas e melhorar o autoatendimento.


O que você fará


Atender jogadores por chat ao vivo, e-mail e redes sociais com clareza, agilidade e empatia

Orientar sobre acesso, contas, transações e funcionalidades da plataforma

Investigar e resolver problemas técnicos básicos com apoio dos sistemas internos e da base de conhecimento

Encaminhar casos complexos para as equipes responsáveis, registrando o contexto e o que já foi verificado

Acompanhar os encaminhamentos necessários para que o jogador não fique sem uma resposta clara

Organizar feedback, reclamações recorrentes e indicadores de atendimento para identificar oportunidades de melhoria

Compartilhar aprendizados com Produto e Desenvolvimento e contribuir para FAQs e materiais de autoatendimento


O que você precisa trazer


Experiência em atendimento ao cliente

Comunicação escrita e verbal clara em português

Empatia e paciência para lidar com situações desafiadoras

Capacidade de investigar problemas, explicar soluções e reconhecer quando um caso precisa ser escalado

Organização para conduzir conversas simultâneas, registrar informações e acompanhar pendências

Discrição e cuidado ao lidar com dados de contas e transações

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala, incluindo fins de semana


Experiência com iGaming ou entretenimento digital, atendimento em tempo real por chat ou redes sociais, resolução de problemas técnicos e familiaridade com jogos são diferenciais, não requisitos.


Salário mensal: R$ 3.000.


Modelo de trabalho: posição remota, aberta a pessoas residentes no Brasil.


Ao se candidatar, conte brevemente sobre uma situação desafiadora de atendimento que você resolveu, como se comunicou e qual foi o resultado.


#JungleGaming #SAC #AtendimentoAoCliente #CustomerSupport #iGaming #RemoteJobs

title: Copywriter
description:
Copywriter · Engage House


Remoto · PJ


Escrever o que sustenta a nossa operação: planejamento mensal, roteiros de vídeo, legendas, carrosséis, copy de anúncio para Meta. Várias marcas ativas ao mesmo tempo, cada uma com tom próprio.


Copy depois do diagnóstico. Você entra em reunião de estratégia, lê briefing de posicionamento, entende a oferta e acompanha performance. Com isso, cria linhas editoriais para cada cliente da sua carteira.


O perfil desejado:


Clareza na estratégia e na escrita. Volume sem perder padrão. Entrega no prazo e responsabilidade para avisar antes quando algo vai atrasar.


Aceita revisão sem levar para o lado pessoal, e defende uma escolha quando tem argumento. Tem repertório para criar com criatividade.


Requisitos:


Português impecável. Noção de funil, oferta e público. Domínio de resposta direta e de conteúdo de topo. Portfólio com peças publicadas, com contexto de cada uma. IA como ferramenta é bem-vinda, texto de robô não passa.


Como funciona:


100% remoto, rotina em ClickUp. Autonomia alta.

title: Accounting Manager – Remote (Work from anywhere)
description:
Fully remote, no night shifts, no commute - work directly with a US finance team from anywhere in India. This is not a BPO role


MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. In India, we are building finance leaders who go beyond execution and take ownership of teams, processes, and client outcomes.


This is not a traditional accounting manager role. You will lead accounting operations for US clients while mentoring and developing your team in a fast-moving environment.


The Opportunity

As an Accounting Manager, you will oversee end-to-end accounting operations for US clients, managing a team of accountants and working directly with US Controllers and CFOs. You will be a key finance partner responsible for accuracy, scalability, and continuous process improvement.


What You Will Own

  • Lead end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients
  • Manage and mentor a team of accountants ensuring quality and professional growth
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles
  • Review and finalize financial statements in compliance with US GAAP
  • Manage multi-location revenue accounting, COGS tracking, and operational expense reconciliations
  • Act as primary US client contact, building strong stakeholder relationships
  • Partner with Controllers and CFOs to support reporting and financial insights
  • Drive process automation and workflow improvements
  • Ensure audit readiness and manage auditor interactions


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP expertise
  • Prior experience in team management or mentoring
  • Background in hospitality, restaurant tech, or multi-location businesses a strong plus
  • Strong understanding of close cycles, financial reporting, and internal controls
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Toast, QuickBooks, or similar)
  • CA / CPA (or equivalent) strongly preferred
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?

  • Lead finance for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Build and manage high-performing accounting teams
  • High ownership and direct visibility with US leadership
  • Fast-track career path to Finance Controller and Head of Finance roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

title: Project Manager
description:
Sobre a Empresa


A SolutionMall é uma plataforma B2B global de produtos profissionais e soluções técnicas integradas. Apoiamos nossos clientes em todo o processo, incluindo levantamento de requisitos, coordenação de soluções, seleção de produtos, coordenação com fornecedores, implementação de projetos e suporte à entrega.


Sobre a Vaga


Estamos procurando um Gerente de Projetos com experiência em instalações de IDC e infraestrutura física de data centers para apoiar a coordenação técnica, implementação e entrega de projetos.

A função abrange sistemas de racks e gabinetes, infraestrutura de energia, sistemas relacionados à refrigeração, cabeamento e outras instalações de suporte em ambientes de IDC e data centers.

Esta é uma oportunidade de cooperação por projeto . O escopo do trabalho, local, cronograma e remuneração serão definidos antes do início de cada projeto.


Responsabilidades


  • Apoiar o levantamento e a definição dos requisitos dos clientes para instalações de data centers
  • Coordenar sistemas de racks e gabinetes, energia, refrigeração, cabeamento e infraestrutura relacionada
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre a infraestrutura física e os equipamentos de servidores, armazenamento e rede
  • Coordenar a comunicação entre clientes, equipes de projeto e equipes técnicas da SolutionMall
  • Apoiar discussões técnicas, esclarecimento de soluções, implementação e entrega de projetos
  • Ajudar a identificar riscos relacionados à preparação da infraestrutura, integração de sistemas e condições do local


Qualificações


  • Experiência em data centers, instalações de IDC ou infraestrutura relacionada
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de racks e gabinetes, energia, refrigeração e infraestrutura de cabeamento
  • Bom conhecimento da infraestrutura física de salas de servidores e data centers
  • Boa capacidade de coordenação técnica e comunicação entre diferentes equipes
  • Inglês fluente


Competências Preferenciais


  • Experiência em projetos de data centers ou instalações de IDC
  • Experiência com implantação de racks e gabinetes ou infraestrutura de suporte
  • Experiência em projetos de data centers modulares ou pré-fabricados


Faixa Salarial e Pacote de Remuneração


Cooperação por projeto. O escopo do trabalho, local, cronograma e remuneração serão definidos antes do início de cada projeto.


Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades


A SolutionMall está comprometida com a diversidade e a inclusão no ambiente de trabalho.


Como se Candidatar


Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail: Candidatura – Gerente de Projetos – Infraestrutura Física de IDC



About the Company


SolutionMall is a global B2B platform for professional products and integrated technical solutions. We support customers through requirement discovery, solution coordination, product selection, supplier coordination, and project implementation and delivery support.


About the Role


We are looking for a Project Manager with experience in IDC facilities and data center physical infrastructure to support technical coordination, project implementation, and delivery. The role covers rack and cabinet systems, supporting power facilities, cooling-related infrastructure, cabling systems, and other supporting hardware facilities inside IDC and data center environments. This is a project-based cooperation opportunity. The work scope, location, schedule, and compensation will be confirmed before each project begins.


Responsibilities


  • Support clarification of customer requirements for data center facilities
  • Coordinate rack and cabinet systems, power, cooling, cabling, and related infrastructure
  • Ensure alignment between infrastructure facilities and servers, storage, and network equipment
  • Coordinate between customers, project teams, and SolutionMall technical teams
  • Support technical discussions, solution clarification, project implementation, and delivery
  • Help identify risks related to infrastructure readiness, system integration, and site conditions


Qualifications


  • Experience in data centers, IDC facilities, or related infrastructure
  • Familiarity with rack and cabinet systems, power, cooling, and cabling infrastructure
  • Good understanding of server room and data center physical facilities
  • Good technical coordination and cross-team communication skills
  • Fluent English


Preferred Skills


  • Experience in data center or IDC facility projects
  • Experience in rack and cabinet deployment or supporting infrastructure
  • Experience in modular or prefabricated data center projects


Pay range and compensation package


Project-based cooperation. The work scope, location, schedule, and compensation will be confirmed before each project begins.


Equal Opportunity Statement


SolutionMall is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.


How to Apply


Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to:


Email subject: Application – Project Manager – IDC Hardware Facilities

title: SEO Expert
description:
What You Will Do

• Run full SEO audits for client websites — find problems, build solutions, track results

• Do keyword research and build content strategies based on search intent, competition,

and SERP behavior

• Implement on-page SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and

content optimization

• Handle technical SEO: site speed, schema markup, structured data, XML sitemaps, 301

redirects, crawl errors, and indexing issues

• Build and manage local SEO strategies: Google Business Profile optimization, citation

management, NAP consistency, and location pages

• Execute link building campaigns: outreach, link auditing, and building high-quality

backlinks

• Write or optimize SEO content: blog posts, landing pages, and service pages that rank

and convert

• Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) to improve SEO workflows — from content ideation

to keyword clustering to technical audits

• Monitor rankings, traffic, and conversions using Google Analytics, Google Search

Console, Semrush, or Ahrefs

• Deliver clear performance reports to account managers and participate in client

communication when needed

• Stay ahead of Google algorithm updates, AI search trends, and emerging SEO tools and

methods

• Optimize for AI and LLM visibility (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) as part of evolving search

strategy



What You Need

• 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience with proven results (traffic growth, ranking

improvements, lead generation)

• Technical SEO skills — site speed, schema, crawl audits, indexing, URL structure. You

know your way around Screaming Frog.

• On-page SEO — keyword optimization, content structure, meta tags, internal linking.

Second nature to you.

• Local SEO — Google Business Profile, citations, location pages, map pack rankings.

This is critical for our clients.

• Link building — experience with outreach, link auditing, and building quality backlinks

that actually move rankings

• SEO tools — Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search

Console. You use these daily.

• AI-powered SEO — you actively use AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar to speed

up keyword research, content optimization, and technical audits

• Content optimization — you can write or improve SEO content that ranks. Blog posts,

service pages, landing pages.

• HTML/CSS basics — enough to make on-page changes, troubleshoot code issues, and

work with developers

• Analytical thinking — you make decisions based on data, not guesses. You can read

reports and spot opportunities.

• Good English communication — you can write clearly, explain your strategy, and

present results to the team



Nice to Have

• Agency experience (managing multiple client accounts at once)

• Experience in Home Services or Healthcare SEO

• Knowledge of JavaScript, PHP, or WordPress development

• Experience with heatmap tools (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity) for user behavior analysis

• CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) experience

• Experience optimizing for AI/LLM search platforms (Perplexity, SearchGPT, etc.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
The role

We are looking for a hands-on business development manager to open new markets and grow our business across Brazil (and LATAM). This is an execution-focused role: identifying the right countries and opportunities, building local relationships, developing a live pipeline and converting opportunities into revenue.


You will work directly with banks, fintechs, payment service providers, mobile operators, government-related organisations, distributors and other local partners. You should be comfortable operating independently, travelling within the region and building a market from the ground up rather than managing an established portfolio.


What you will do

  • Identify and prioritise new LATAM markets based on customer demand, competitive landscape, route to market and commercial potential.
  • Build market-entry plans for priority countries, including target accounts, local partners, product fit, pricing approach and expected sales pipeline.
  • Develop relationships with banks, fintechs, payment service providers, mobile operators, distributors, government-related organisations and other relevant customers.
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, opening doors, understanding customer needs, coordinating proposals and product demonstrations, negotiating commercial terms and closing deals.
  • Build and maintain a credible pipeline with clear next steps, deal value, probability, decision makers and expected closing dates.
  • Identify, assess and manage local agents, distributors or strategic partners where they provide a faster or more effective route to market.
  • Work closely with product, technical, operations, finance and legal teams to develop workable customer solutions and move opportunities through to delivery.
  • Track tenders and major market opportunities, qualify them early and coordinate submissions with internal teams.
  • Provide practical market intelligence on customer demand, competitors, pricing, regulation and emerging opportunities.
  • Maintain disciplined sales reporting and provide accurate forecasts, risks and actions required from management.
  • Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events and partner discussions across the region, and support account follow-up where commercial issues affect delivery or payment.


What success looks like

  • Priority markets are selected based on evidence, with a clear entry plan for each market.
  • A healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities is built, with access to genuine decision makers rather than only intermediaries.
  • New customers and partners are converted into signed commercial opportunities and revenue.
  • Forecasts and pipeline updates are reliable, current and supported by clear next actions.
  • Internal teams receive enough commercial and market information to make timely decisions and deliver effectively.


What we are looking for

  • Strong business development or enterprise sales experience in one or more LATAM markets.
  • Proven ability to open new markets, build relationships from scratch and convert opportunities without relying on an established customer base.
  • Relevant network and experience within banking, payments, fintech, smart cards, terminals, telecommunications, digital identity or related technology sectors.
  • Commercially sharp and able to qualify opportunities, negotiate effectively and focus time on deals that can realistically close.
  • Hands-on, resourceful and comfortable working independently across markets with different business practices and levels of structure.
  • Able to communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, including translating market needs into specific commercial and technical requirements.
  • Strong judgement when selecting partners, managing sensitive relationships and assessing commercial or reputational risk.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently across LATAM.


Preferred background

  • Experience selling to banks, fintechs, payment service providers, mobile operators or government-linked customers.
  • Understanding of payment cards, card personalisation, POS terminals, digital payment solutions, SIM/eSIM or adjacent technologies.
  • Experience working across more than one LATAM market and managing cross-border sales cycles.


Role fit

This role suits someone who enjoys being in the market, meeting customers, opening doors and creating opportunities. It is not a people-management or strategy-only position. The successful candidate will be expected to personally drive execution and results.

  • Strong business development or enterprise sales experience in one or more LATAM markets.
  • Proven ability to open new markets, build relationships from scratch and convert opportunities without relying on an established customer base.
  • Relevant network and experience within banking, payments, fintech, smart cards, terminals, telecommunications, digital identity or related technology sectors.
  • Commercially sharp and able to qualify opportunities, negotiate effectively and focus time on deals that can realistically close.
  • Hands-on, resourceful and comfortable working independently across markets with different business practices and levels of structure.
  • Able to communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, including translating market needs into specific commercial and technical requirements.
  • Strong judgement when selecting partners, managing sensitive relationships and assessing commercial or reputational risk.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently across LATAM.


Preferred background

  • Experience selling to banks, fintechs, payment service providers, mobile operators or government-linked customers.
  • Understanding of payment cards, card personalisation, POS terminals, digital payment solutions, SIM/eSIM or adjacent technologies.
  • Experience working across more than one LATAM market and managing cross-border sales cycles.


Role fit

This role suits someone who enjoys being in the market, meeting customers, opening doors and creating opportunities. It is not a people-management or strategy-only position. The successful candidate will be expected to personally drive execution and results.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
The role

We are looking for a hands-on business development manager to open new markets and grow our business across Brazil (and LATAM). This is an execution-focused role: identifying the right countries and opportunities, building local relationships, developing a live pipeline and converting opportunities into revenue.


You will work directly with banks, fintechs, payment service providers, mobile operators, government-related organisations, distributors and other local partners. You should be comfortable operating independently, travelling within the region and building a market from the ground up rather than managing an established portfolio.


What you will do

  • Identify and prioritise new LATAM markets based on customer demand, competitive landscape, route to market and commercial potential.
  • Build market-entry plans for priority countries, including target accounts, local partners, product fit, pricing approach and expected sales pipeline.
  • Develop relationships with banks, fintechs, payment service providers, mobile operators, distributors, government-related organisations and other relevant customers.
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, opening doors, understanding customer needs, coordinating proposals and product demonstrations, negotiating commercial terms and closing deals.
  • Build and maintain a credible pipeline with clear next steps, deal value, probability, decision makers and expected closing dates.
  • Identify, assess and manage local agents, distributors or strategic partners where they provide a faster or more effective route to market.
  • Work closely with product, technical, operations, finance and legal teams to develop workable customer solutions and move opportunities through to delivery.
  • Track tenders and major market opportunities, qualify them early and coordinate submissions with internal teams.
  • Provide practical market intelligence on customer demand, competitors, pricing, regulation and emerging opportunities.
  • Maintain disciplined sales reporting and provide accurate forecasts, risks and actions required from management.
  • Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events and partner discussions across the region, and support account follow-up where commercial issues affect delivery or payment.


What success looks like

  • Priority markets are selected based on evidence, with a clear entry plan for each market.
  • A healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities is built, with access to genuine decision makers rather than only intermediaries.

title: English Teacher | Professor(a) de Inglês — Remoto
description:
A FLIPT English está em busca de 2 English Teachers para fazer parte do nosso time, com possibilidade de inclusão em um banco de reserva para futuras contratações.


Acreditamos que aprender inglês pode ser uma experiência mais leve, humana e possível. Por isso, buscamos professores que unam qualidade educacional, clareza e acolhimento, ajudando adultos a superar bloqueios, recuperar a confiança e viver o idioma de forma prática.


RESPONSABILIDADES

Você conduzirá aulas individuais e em grupo para adultos, trabalhando conteúdos de inglês geral, Business English e preparação para exames de proficiência.


Será responsável por conduzir aulas on-line com clareza, dinamismo e foco em situações reais de comunicação, acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos alunos e contribuir para uma experiência de aprendizagem positiva, profissional e acolhedora.


A agenda terá flexibilidade: você disponibilizará seus horários no Calendly, e os alunos realizarão os agendamentos de acordo com essa disponibilidade. É indispensável ter disponibilidade para atuar em turnos da noite.


REQUISITOS

  • Experiência prévia com ensino de inglês na modalidade on-line.
  • Certificação de proficiência em inglês (TOEFL, IELTS ou exame compatível).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos da noite.
  • Organização e autonomia para trabalhar com uma agenda flexível no Calendly.
  • Boa comunicação e compromisso com uma experiência de aprendizagem acolhedora, prática e profissional.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência com preparação de alunos para os exames TOEFL, IELTS ou CAE.
  • Experiência com aulas para adultos.


O QUE A FLIPT OFERECE

  • A contratação será PJ, com possibilidade de atuação de até 20 horas semanais .
  • Durante o primeiro mês, período de treinamento inicial, o valor será de R$ 30 por hora . Após essa etapa, o valor da hora será aberto à negociação .
  • A oportunidade também inclui porcentagem sobre indicações e participação nos lucros , conforme os critérios definidos pela FLIPT.


COMO SE CANDIDATAR

  • Envie seu currículo para com o assunto “Vaga English Teacher — FLIPT”.
  • No corpo do e-mail, conte brevemente sobre sua experiência com aulas on-line, sua certificação de proficiência e sua disponibilidade semanal, especialmente no período noturno.
