title: Analista administrativo-financeiro
description:
Analista administrativo-financeiro


* Trabalho remoto, porém com participação presencial em eventos e/ou reuniões extraordinárias no Rio de Janeiro e/ou São Paulo.


A Sob Investigação é uma empresa que cria experiências interativas com jogos investigativos. Desenvolvemos, produzimos e comercializamos nossos produtos para todo o Brasil e mundo através de diversos canais de venda, incluindo e-commerce próprio, marketplaces e revenda em pontos físicos.


Estamos em um momento de crescimento e buscamos uma pessoa para assumir uma posição, responsável por estruturar nossa área financeira e monitorar a saúde da empresa, assim como garantir que as operações do dia a dia sejam executadas da forma correta. Hoje essas atividades são desempenhadas por um dos sócios e queremos alguém para absorver essa carga de trabalho e para implementar profissionalismos em nossas rotinas.


Procuramos alguém que goste de aprender sobre funcionamento da empresa como um todo, estruturar processos, participar ativamente do monitoramento da operação e tenha proatividade em ir atrás das informações que precisa para cumprir suas metas e objetivos.


#Principais responsabilidades


1 - Financeiro


* Estruturar e elaborar o DRE gerencial da empresa, realizando todo a coleta, organização e classificação das receitas, custos e despesas necessários.

* Desenvolver controles internos que garantam informações financeiras confiáveis e consistentes mensalmente.

* Realizar conciliações bancárias.

* Elaborar projeções financeiras, fluxo de caixa e apoiar o planejamento financeiro da empresa.

* Gerenciar a emissão de notas fiscais, incluindo parametrizações em plataformas e sistemas.

* Gerenciar o faturamento de clientes B2B, acompanhando cobranças, pagamentos e garantindo a correta conclusão das operações.

* Emitir notas complementares, cartas de correção e notas de devolução quando necessário.

* Atuar como principal interface entre a empresa e o nosso escritório de contabilidade, acompanhando entregas, validando informações, tirando dúvidas, pedindo ajuda e garantindo o melhor aproveitamento do serviço contratado.

* Identificar inconsistências fiscais e oportunidades de melhoria tributária e operacional.


2 - Indicadores e Inteligência de Negócio


* Organizar e popular ferramenta de cálculo indicadores financeiros e operacionais para acompanhamento da empresa.

* Produzir análises que auxiliem a diretoria na tomada de decisão.

* Identificar oportunidades/suspeitas para redução de custos e/ou ganho de eficiência a partir do contato com os números do dia-a-dia.

* Analisar dados de vendas, desempenho dos canais e comportamento dos clientes para geração de insights.


3 - Gestão do estoque


* Elaborar projeções de reposição de estoque.

* Planejar a distribuição de produtos entre centros de distribuição e canais de venda.

* Executar as atividades necessárias para garantir que o estoque correto esteja no local certo e no momento certo, incluindo contratação de transportadoras, agendamento de coletas, acompanhamento de entregas e demais atividades relacionadas à movimentação de mercadorias em operações de atacado/institucionais (não inclui logística ou atendimento ao cliente final).


#Habilidades essenciais


* Experiência na construção de DRE gerencial, incluindo levantamento, organização e classificação de receitas, custos e despesas.

* Experiência na criação e acompanhamento de indicadores gerenciais.

* Experiência com operações de e-commerce no setor financeiro-administrativo.

* Experiência com ERPs, plataformas de e-commerce e emissão de notas fiscais.

* Perfil analítico e organizado.

* Capacidade de estruturar processos, cobrar pessoas e trabalhar com autonomia.


# Diferenciais


* Conhecimento em planejamento de estoque, logística e distribuição.

* Experiência utilizando ferramentas de IA e vibecoding para desenvolver automações, dashboards ou soluções internas.

* Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de e-commerce e automação de processos.


# Modelo de trabalho


* Contratação PJ.

* Trabalho remoto, porém com participação presencial em eventos e/ou reuniões extraordinárias no Rio e/ou São Paulo.

* Preferencialmente candidatos residentes no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou regiões próximas.


# Como é trabalhar na Sob Investigação


Somos uma produtora de jogos próprios e nova no mercado, porém em crescimento rápido e grande presença nas redes sociais.

A multidisciplinaridade não significa uma carga de trabalho incompatível com apenas 1 profissional. Significa que ainda não temos o tamanho e complexidade de operação que gere demanda suficiente para alocar uma pessoa dedicada a cada especialidade listada acima.


Esta é uma posição com elevado nível de autonomia e é a primeira vaga financeiro-administrativa aberta na empresa, logo é uma oportunidade para quem acredita no nosso projeto e quer construir e administrar um departamento inteiro no futuro. O profissional responderá diretamente ao sócio fundador responsável pela área financeira e terá liberdade para propor melhorias, implementar controles, estruturar processos e contribuir ativamente para o desenvolvimento da empresa.


Se você gosta de ambientes dinâmicos, onde seu trabalho influencia diretamente no resultado no negócio e de produto que o cliente terá contato, onde há espaço para construir em vez de apenas executar, gostaríamos de conhecer você.

* Emitir notas complementares, cartas de correção e notas de devolução quando necessário.

* Atuar como principal interface entre a empresa e o nosso escritório de contabilidade, acompanhando entregas, validando informações, tirando dúvidas, pedindo ajuda e garantindo o melhor aproveitamento do serviço contratado.

* Identificar inconsistências fiscais e oportunidades de melhoria tributária e operacional.


2 - Indicadores e Inteligência de Negócio


* Organizar e popular ferramenta de cálculo indicadores financeiros e operacionais para acompanhamento da empresa.

* Produzir análises que auxiliem a diretoria na tomada de decisão.

* Identificar oportunidades/suspeitas para redução de custos e/ou ganho de eficiência a partir do contato com os números do dia-a-dia.

* Analisar dados de vendas, desempenho dos canais e comportamento dos clientes para geração de insights.


3 - Gestão do estoque


* Elaborar projeções de reposição de estoque.

* Planejar a distribuição de produtos entre centros de distribuição e canais de venda.

* Executar as atividades necessárias para garantir que o estoque correto esteja no local certo e no momento certo, incluindo contratação de transportadoras, agendamento de coletas, acompanhamento de entregas e demais atividades relacionadas à movimentação de mercadorias em operações de atacado/institucionais (não inclui logística ou atendimento ao cliente final).


#Habilidades essenciais


* Experiência na construção de DRE gerencial, incluindo levantamento, organização e classificação de receitas, custos e despesas.

* Experiência na criação e acompanhamento de indicadores gerenciais.

* Experiência com operações de e-commerce no setor financeiro-administrativo.

* Experiência com ERPs, plataformas de e-commerce e emissão de notas fiscais.

* Perfil analítico e organizado.

* Capacidade de estruturar processos, cobrar pessoas e trabalhar com autonomia.


# Diferenciais


* Conhecimento em planejamento de estoque, logística e distribuição.

* Experiência utilizando ferramentas de IA e vibecoding para desenvolver automações, dashboards ou soluções internas.

* Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de e-commerce e automação de processos.


# Modelo de trabalho


* Contratação PJ.

* Trabalho remoto, porém com participação presencial em eventos e/ou reuniões extraordinárias no Rio e/ou São Paulo.

* Preferencialmente candidatos residentes no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou regiões próximas.


# Como é trabalhar na Sob Investigação


Somos uma produtora de jogos próprios e nova no mercado, porém em crescimento rápido e grande presença nas redes sociais.

A multidisciplinaridade não significa uma carga de trabalho incompatível com apenas 1 profissional. Significa que ainda não temos o tamanho e complexidade de operação que gere demanda suficiente para alocar uma pessoa dedicada a cada especialidade listada acima.


Esta é uma posição com elevado nível de autonomia e é a primeira vaga financeiro-administrativa aberta na empresa, logo é uma oportunidade para quem acredita no nosso projeto e quer construir e administrar um departamento inteiro no futuro. O profissional responderá diretamente ao sócio fundador responsável pela área financeira e terá liberdade para propor melhorias, implementar controles, estruturar processos e contribuir ativamente para o desenvolvimento da empresa.


Se você gosta de ambientes dinâmicos, onde seu trabalho influencia diretamente no resultado no negócio e de produto que o cliente terá contato, onde há espaço para construir em vez de apenas executar, gostaríamos de conhecer você.

title: AI Growth Marketer for Global Running Company
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.


This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would simply write the good, the bad and the ugly about being our AI Growth Marketer.


I just need one really good applicant!


Let me start with the company. In Go! Running Tours we are working on a global scale, we operate in the intersection between running and travel and you’ll be joining a company that already works with some of the leading brands in the industry. It is equally fun and exciting.


Now for the role. I am looking for someone who can combine outstanding marketing understanding and experience with technical superskills to build a team of agents that improves efficiency and, most importantly, grows revenue. 


The ideal candidate will have experience in building marketing AI workflows and agents across research, data analysis, campaign creation and content creation. This is a unique opportunity to take a leap both skills and careerwise and without any red tape or delays. If you have full responsibility and if you have an idea you want to test, you get a quick “go” and then you are off you go to build, test and scale. 


This role is 80% execution and 20% strategy. With time, these numbers will switch, but right here and now, we are looking for someone to pull up their sleeves, put on their AI marketing hat and get stuck in.

It’s not all AI. Good old marketing skills are critical for this role. Email marketing, outbound campaigns, case study creation and sponsorships will all be part of your responsibility. You should get a kick out of working with sales and partners to deliver results and grow the business.


I am looking for someone in constant growth mode: always looking for ways to grow the business, develop personally, research new markets and explore new tech, trends and ways of doing things. I am a super user of podcasts, and I want a colleague who is always one day ahead of me and answers “I’m already testing it” when I say, “Hey, I just heard XXX, should we be trying this out?” 🙌


Now to the bad. Our budgets are not “to infinity and back”, so you’ll not find yourself swimming in unlimited AI tokens and campaign budgets like Uncle Scrooge in his money bin.

And the ugly. There will also be plenty of unsexy work that we can’t “agent” ourselves out of, at least to begin with. Rest assured, you are not alone. All of us do the unsexy.


You will be working directly with me. I love my job, and every day I am grateful to work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful and positive.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world. Together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!


Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, focus radically on progress and dislike sloppiness with a passion. Most people, I believe, or at least hope, also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting and understanding. Admittedly, I still have very little understanding of sloppiness ;-).

My guess is that if you are good at what you do, talented in marketing and AI, eager to grow and excited to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!


We work remotely and have only 2 to 3 hours of internal meetings a week. The rest is reserved for deep work and getting things done. We are all on Slack, and there is always time for a call, so you’re never left alone. We’re just on the other side of the world 😉.


The salary will not secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius, and money should not be your main motivation. Running, B2B growth, building with AI, bridging cultures and being part of a fun, fast-moving and positive company should.


The contract details are as follows:

USD 2,100 per month

40 hrs per week

Managed via Upwork on a freelance basis


The most important traits to bring to the role are those of a fast mover, a super collaborator and an executor, not the beheading kind, but the “get s*** done” kind. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.


If you feel this role could be for you, please write to me via with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours.

Please do not send me a generic AI application. I want to hear from the real you, not the “highly motivated individual with a passion for innovative growth strategies” version 😉.


The recruitment process includes logical and personality test as well as two interviews. 


Thanks for reading this far,

Lena


Note: We usually take down our job posts within 3 to 4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: Fullstack Technical Lead
description:
Fullstack Sênior / Líder Técnico(a) | Remoto | React, Node.js e Java

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior / Líder Técnico(a) para se juntar ao nosso time na OSF Digital.


O profissional ideal possui sólida experiência em desenvolvimento fullstack com React, Node.js e Java, além de conhecimentos em arquitetura de software, APIs, microsserviços, cloud e liderança técnica. A atuação será 100% remota, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares na criação de soluções completas, eficientes, escaláveis e resilientes.


Sobre a vaga

Você será responsável por liderar tecnicamente um squad de desenvolvedores, orientando a definição de arquitetura, o desenvolvimento e a entrega de aplicações fullstack. Também atuará como referência técnica para garantir a qualidade do código, a aplicação de boas práticas e a evolução contínua das soluções.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar um squad de desenvolvedores, oferecendo liderança técnica, mentoria e direcionamento para o desenvolvimento dos projetos;
  • Responder ao Especialista de TI e ao Coordenador de TI;
  • Definir a arquitetura de aplicações fullstack robustas, alinhadas às necessidades do negócio e aos padrões de desempenho;
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em características de sistema, estratégias e padrões de design reutilizáveis;
  • Considerar aspectos como adaptabilidade, escalabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e resiliência;
  • Supervisionar o desenvolvimento de componentes front-end e back-end;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código, a aplicação de boas práticas e a integração entre as camadas da aplicação;
  • Realizar revisões de código e gerenciar o controle de versão;
  • Garantir a manutenção, a evolução e a escalabilidade da base de código;
  • Promover a adoção de boas práticas e tecnologias de desenvolvimento, incluindo DevOps, SRE, segurança, integração contínua e serviços em nuvem;
  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos em toda a stack;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior e/ou Líder Técnico(a);

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todos os indivíduos e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, nacionalidade, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em nenhuma das jurisdições em que atuamos.

Vem construir o futuro com a gente!Technical Lead | Remote | React, Node.js and Java


---------------------------------------------------------------------


Technical Lead | Remote | React, Node.js, and Java

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer / Technical Lead to join our team at OSF Digital.


The ideal candidate has solid experience in fullstack development using React, Node.js, and Java, as well as knowledge of software architecture, APIs, microservices, cloud technologies, and technical leadership. This is a 100% remote position, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to create complete, efficient, scalable, and resilient solutions.


About the Role

You will be responsible for providing technical leadership to a development squad, guiding architecture decisions, application development, and delivery. You will also act as a technical reference, ensuring code quality, the adoption of best practices, and the continuous evolution of our solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead a development squad by providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance throughout project development;
  • Report to the IT Specialist and IT Coordinator;
  • Define the architecture of robust fullstack applications aligned with business needs and performance standards;
  • Translate business requirements into system features, reusable strategies, and design patterns;
  • Consider aspects such as adaptability, scalability, availability, security, and resilience;
  • Oversee the development of front-end and back-end components;
  • Ensure code quality, the adoption of best practices, and integration between application layers;
  • Conduct code reviews and manage version control;
  • Ensure the maintainability, evolution, and scalability of the codebase;
  • Promote the adoption of development best practices and technologies, including DevOps, SRE, security, continuous integration, and cloud services;
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across the entire technology stack;
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Senior Fullstack Developer and/or Technical Lead;
  • Experience designing software architectures, APIs, and microservices;
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and front-end frameworks;
  • Mandatory experience with React;
  • Proficiency in back-end development using Java and Node.js;
  • Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP;
  • Experience with or knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Knowledge of the software development lifecycle and agile methodologies;
  • Strong leadership, mentoring, and team management skills;
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities;
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact with stakeholders at different levels;
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable terms;
  • Availability to work remotely.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with DevOps and SRE practices;
  • Knowledge of distributed architectures and resilient systems;
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines;
  • Certifications in cloud, software architecture, or related technologies;
  • Graduate degree or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.


Why Join OSF Digital?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package focused on your well-being, professional development, and career growth, in an inclusive environment where you can be yourself.


Employment Model and Benefits

  • CLT employment contract;

  • Life insurance;

title: Consultor SAP FI Sênior (PJ)
description:
Qual será o seu papel? 😉

• Atuar em projeto SAP S/4HANA relacionado à incorporação e integração de empresas, com foco nos processos financeiros e contábeis

• Realizar levantamento de requisitos e desenho dos processos To-Be para a nova operação

• Configurar e parametrizar o módulo SAP FI em S/4HANA

• Apoiar a harmonização de plano de contas, centros de custo e estruturas organizacionais

• Participar da definição e execução da estratégia de migração de saldos e dados mestres financeiros

• Elaborar especificações funcionais para desenvolvimentos relacionados ao módulo FI

• Participar das atividades de cutover, reconciliação, go-live e hypercare

• Atuar em conjunto com áreas como Contabilidade, Controladoria e Tesouraria e com módulos CO, MM e SD


Esperamos que você tenha: 😊

• Experiência sênior em projetos SAP FI, incluindo ciclos completos de implementação e/ou rollout

• Domínio dos processos de General Ledger, Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber, Ativo Fixo e fechamento contábil

• Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e conceitos como Universal Journal/ACDOCA, New Asset Accounting e Business Partner

• Conhecimento de processos bancários, pagamentos e conciliação

• Experiência com localização Brasil e processos fiscais aplicáveis ao FI

• Conhecimento das integrações entre FI e módulos CO, MM, SD e Tesouraria

• Experiência com migração e reconciliação de saldos contábeis e financeiros


Vamos ficar feliz se você tiver (seu diferencial):

• Experiência em projetos de incorporação, M&A, fusão, cisão ou carve-out

• Vivência com cutover plan, mock runs e balanço de abertura

• Experiência com Migration Cockpit/LTMC ou ferramentas similares

• Conhecimento de compliance e auditoria, incluindo ambientes SOX

• Experiência com SAP Fiori aplicado aos processos financeiros

• Certificação SAP FI / S/4HANA


Modelo de atuação: Híbrido - 2x a 3x na semana - Vila Olímpia, São Paulo/SP

Contratação PJ

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Salesforce Jr
description:
A Everymind , fundada em novembro de 2014, é parceira oficial da Salesforce desde 2015 e especialista multicloud. Desenvolvemos soluções que transformam negócios de todos os portes e setores, unindo visão 360°, expertise tecnológica e uma mentalidade de inovação pioneira.


Somos parte da AI/R , a AI Revolution Company. Uma conexão estratégica de componentes revolucionários que incorporam a Inteligência Artificial por completo.


Você gosta de um desafio ? Junte-se a nós, venha ser um Everyminder!



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Desenvolvimento em Apex (classes, triggers e testes).

• Parametrizações nivel básico Salesforce.

• Criação de componentes Lightning Web Components.

• Criar campos, layouts, perfis, flows, validation rule, approval process

• Implementação de automações declarativas.

• Construção de integrações simples.

• Correção de incidentes e bugs.

• Participação ativa em code review.

• Apoio em deploys e gestão de ambientes.

• Atualização de documentação técnica.

• Organizar as próprias atividades no JIRA/Trello/Azure

• Participar das cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review, retrospectiva).


Requisitos e qualificações:

• Experiência com desenvolvimento Salesforce Core (Sales e Service Cloud) de pelo menos 1 ano;

• Experiência prática em projetos Salesforce.

• Domínio básico/intermediário de Apex, SOQL e LWC.

• Conhecimento em integrações REST.

• Conhecimento em modelagem de dados.

• Versionamento (Git).


Benefícios oferecidos:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados
  • Programa de apoio a certificações
  • Plano de Assistência Médica (com coparticipação e mensalidade para dependentes)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Zenklub
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Programa Talkers – apoio no inglês
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino com descontos em cursos MBA e pós-graduação

Opcionais com mensalidade

  • Plano Odontológico
  • Total Pass

title: Consultor(a) Contábil Sênior — PJ
description:
Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Contábil Sênior para atuar como referência técnica na condução da rotina contábil, com foco em qualidade, conformidade e melhoria de processos.


Principais entregas

  • Conduzir a transição da função contábil do modelo terceirizado para a estrutura interna
  • Conduzir o ciclo contábil completo: livro-razão, conciliações, fechamento mensal e anual
  • Garantir a preparação precisa e tempestiva das demonstrações financeiras, conforme normas aplicáveis
  • Revisar lançamentos contábeis, conciliações de balanço e registros contábeis
  • Articular-se com auditores externos, consultores tributários e órgãos reguladores
  • Contribuir para a manutenção e evolução de processos, controles internos e documentação contábil
  • Apoiar a otimização do ERP e melhorias nos sistemas contábeis
  • Atuar em conjunto com outras áreas do negócio para garantir a precisão do reporte financeiro
  • Preparar relatórios gerenciais que apoiem a tomada de decisão


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis
  • Registro ativo no CRC
  • 5 a 6 anos de experiência contábil, com passagem por posições de maior senioridade
  • Experiência prática com SAP Business One (SAP B1)
  • Conhecimento sólido de princípios contábeis, reporte financeiro e fechamento mensal
  • Inglês para comunicação (escrita e falada) com stakeholders internacionais


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas multinacionais
  • Vivência em processos de transição de contabilidade terceirizada para modelo interno
  • Perfil orientado à melhoria de processos e boas práticas
  • Excel avançado
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia, conduzindo entregas de ponta a ponta


Modalidade

  • Contrato PJ · Remoto · Brasil

description:

Industry: Pharmaceutical


We are seeking an experienced Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead to support a major transformation programme within a global pharmaceutical organisation.   • Collaborate closely with Regional Americas and Global OCM teams to ensure alignment with overall change strategy and methodology.

Required Experience

  • Proven experience leading Organizational Change Management initiatives within large-scale transformation programmes.
  • Strong understanding of OCM methodologies (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent).
  • Experience in stakeholder management, communications planning, change impact assessments, and organisational readiness.
  • Ability to work across multiple countries and cultures in a regional environment.
  • Previous pharmaceutical, life sciences, or highly regulated industry experience preferred.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English are essential. Spanish is advantageous.


Contract Details

  • Duration: 6 Months
  • Location: Brazil
  • Start: ASAP


This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned Change Management professional to support a strategic transformation programme within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

title: Recruiter/ Onboarder
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post. Instead of the classic recruiter ad filled with words like “dynamic,” “self-starter,” and “people person,” I thought I’d simply share the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Recruiter & Onboarder with Go! Running Tours.


Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one.


So, let’s start.


Our new Recruiter/Onboarder will be responsible for finding, selecting, and onboard the incredible running guides who make Go! Running Tours what it is today.


You should get a kick out of owning the entire process from identifying candidates to bringing them to the finish line. We are not looking for quick fix recruiters, but for that one person who is able to recruit colleagues who will work with us for the next 5, 10, 15 years. Because truly good colleagues are hard to come by and even harder to let go 😊.


In the team, we have everything from bike messengers to professors, from a young and fast 22-year-old, to an even faster retiree (sub 3 marathon type of retiree ). Your job will be to identify these candidates, bring them on board, and assist them in the early steps of their journey and ensure the quality of our tours.


The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skills of all are: execution and persistency (not the annoying type, but the type that brings you to the finish line of a marathon). And this is likely where the “ugly” comes in, because our colleagues have different backgrounds, different personalities and different lives outside Go! Running Tours. That means that some of our colleagues complete the onboarding and associated tasks without blinking and to perfection, while others may need more support and follow-up to reach the finish line. 


You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that \"makes sense\" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world — and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!


Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!


We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for interviews and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world 😉.


The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should. 


The contract details are as follows:

Contract details are as follows:

10 hrs/week

USD 12/hr + bonus

Managed via upwork


That’s it, I think. I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.


If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version 😉).


All the best and happy running,

Lena

title: Head of Retention
description:
Head of Retention

Talent Global LLC — Latin America (Remote)

Full-Time (40 Hours/Week) | US Eastern Time | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing US-based direct-to-consumer brand at the intersection of beauty, lifestyle, and functional product design, currently operating at an eight-figure annual run rate with a clear trajectory toward $100M. They are hiring a Head of Retention to own email and SMS as a top revenue line, build the full lifecycle engine end-to-end, and compound the program as the business scales. This is a builder's seat with real authority — you will report to the Head of Marketing, direct a small team of designers and specialists, and be measured directly on retention revenue, LTV, and repeat purchase rate.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own retention strategy and revenue — email and SMS contribution to total revenue, flow revenue, campaign revenue, repeat purchase rate, and 90-day retention
  • Build and optimize complete email and SMS flow sets across every product funnel and paid landing page simultaneously (welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandon, checkout, post-purchase, win-back, and the full 90-day LTV journey)
  • Own sitewide opt-in coverage — every paid landing page with its full flow set tagged to its opt-in, including technical integrity of subscriber entry and tracking
  • Design and evolve a sophisticated segmentation strategy by product interest, behavior, and value, paired with strong list health and deliverability management
  • Own the full monthly calendar end-to-end — daily email plus weekly SMS plan, including segmentation, exclusions, offers, send times, and forecasted revenue per send
  • Design and run the QA system that keeps every send on-brand, accurate, and on-offer before it ships
  • Hold brand voice and editorial craft across the entire program — cultural fluency, nuance, and the ability to make the customer feel seen
  • Build AI-driven automations for QA, segmentation, reporting, competitor monitoring, and campaign generation on top of proprietary infrastructure
  • Run a structured weekly testing program across subject lines, segmentation, timing, content angles, and flow triggers — codify wins and carry learnings forward
  • Own revenue forecasting per send and per flow, reviewed against actuals, plus weekly stats, flow benchmarks, and performance reporting
  • Direct and develop designers, specialists, and contractors who execute the program


Requirements

  • 6+ years in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email and SMS marketing, with experience inside a brand or agency scaling eight- or nine-figure DTC brands where retention was owned as a meaningful share of revenue
  • Deep, hands-on technical mastery of Klaviyo — flow architecture, triggers and conditions, opt-in and source tracking, suppressions, and deliverability — built and debugged independently
  • You build, debug, and deploy flows and campaigns directly in Klaviyo — independently, without technical support.
  • Hands-on experience with Postscript or a comparable SMS platform at a lifecycle strategy level
  • Proven, meaningful improvement to customer lifetime value in a durable goods or considered-purchase category
  • Experience building complete flow coverage across a multi-product catalog and improving several funnels in parallel
  • Genuine AI fluency as a builder — you have built AI-driven automations using tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Make.com for tasks such as QA, segmentation, campaign generation, or reporting. This is not a nice-to-have; it is core to how this brand operates.
  • Sophisticated segmentation and data fluency — designs segmentation that compounds over time and reads performance data to drive decisions
  • Strong editorial and cultural sensibility — holds a distinct brand voice and catches the nuance that elevates a program
  • Experience directing specialists or contractors against a clear standard of output and quality
  • Comfortable in a founder-led, high-growth environment where pace, ownership, and impact are part of the culture


Nice to Have

  • Experience in beauty, hair care, accessories, or apparel
  • Track record building retention reporting or automation infrastructure from the ground up
  • Experience scaling SMS into a material standalone revenue channel
  • Experience supporting a brand through wholesale, retail, or international expansion


Ideal Candidate

This role is built for someone who is energized by owning a function outright. You anticipate gaps, close them early, bring solutions, and move the number. You are technically deep in Klaviyo and SMS, analytically fluent, and editorially sharp enough to hold a distinct brand voice at scale. You have already stood up retention programs at eight-figure brands and you know what good looks like — not just in metrics, but in the quality of the program. You bring AI into your workflow as a builder, not just a user. You thrive in lean, founder-led, fast-moving environments where ambiguity is normal, priorities shift quickly, and your work is visible from day one. If you need extensive process, handholding, or a structured corporate environment to do your best work, this is not the right role.

title: Healthcare Data Analyst
description:
Company: Herself Health

Title: Data Analyst

Location: REMOTE (Brazil or Columbia)

Duration: 6 month contract

Interview: 1 round



Required Skills & Experience

· 1–3 years of hands-on experience as a data analyst, analytics intern, or similar role (healthcare, value-based care, or related field preferred

· Working proficiency in SQL, including joins, aggregation, window functions, and CTEs, and comfort querying a cloud data warehouse or (Databricks preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift also acceptable)

· Demonstrated ability to reconcile and validate a dataset against an independent source and explain a variance — not just produce a number

· Experience building or contributing to dashboards in a modern BI tool (Power BI, Looker, or similar)

· Foundational understanding of healthcare data sources such as claims, EHR, HEDIS, and risk adjustment — academic or internship exposure counts

· Familiarity with data governance, security, and HIPAA-compliant practices

· Excellent attention to detail, with a habit of sanity-checking your own work before it ships

· Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to run a requirements conversation with a non-technical stakeholder

Comfort working in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environment


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

· Basic proficiency in Python or similar for analysis and lightweight automation

· Exposure to dbt — reading models, tests, and documentation; understanding how a mart is assembled (building models is not required for this role)

· Familiarity with version control and pull-request workflows in Git

· Understanding of CMS quality programs (HEDIS, MIPS, Star Ratings), risk adjustment and RAF/HCC concepts, or population health

· Experience working with payor eligibility, attribution, or claims extract files


Job Description

We are looking for a motivated Data Analyst who will help turn healthcare data into clear, actionable insights that improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency. Reporting to the Director of Information Technology, you will be the connection between the people who ask the questions — clinical operations, product, finance, and quality — and the data team that answers them.

You will spend your time understanding what our existing datasets and dashboards actually mean, translating business questions into clear analytical requirements, checking that the numbers we publish are correct, and explaining the results to people who do not work in data all day. You will work in Databricks SQL (Unity Catalog), read and interpret dbt-built marts, and support Zeno BI dashboards (our custom BI application). You are not expected to build or own production pipelines — you are expected to know the outputs cold and catch it when they are wrong.

description:
🚀 Sobre nós: O ibe.IA (Instituto Brasileiro de Educação em Inteligência Artificial) é a maior escola de IA da América Latina. Atuamos em Vibe Coding (criação de apps, SaaS e sistemas com IA), Agentes IA e Automações, IA para Negócios e Mentoria AI First. Rodamos campanhas perpétuas no Meta, Google e YouTube, o que demanda alto volume de criativos editados, com qualidade consistente e criatividade.


Posição: Criador de Vídeos com IA

Localização: Remota

✅ Contratação: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Inscrições até 25/08/2026


Responsabilidades:

  • Produzir criativos de tráfego em vídeo com IA para redes sociais e ads: 10 por semana
  • Produzir locuções e dublagens com IA de voz (ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS ou similar), inclusive testes A/B com voz
  • Aplicar legendagem estilizada automática
  • Manter status atualizado no ClickUp e comunicar bloqueios ou atrasos
  • Documentar fluxo de produção


O que oferecemos:

  • Flexibilidade pra trabalhar de qualquer lugar.
  • Treinamento abrangente sobre as ferramentas que ensinamos e o universo de IA aplicada.
  • Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora e em constante crescimento.
  • Acesso à biblioteca completa de IA generativa da operação
  • Licença de acesso à plataforma da ibe.IA (todas as formações).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em produzir vídeos com IA desde o roteiro, personagens, áudio e animações
  • Apresentação de portfólio com vídeos autorais
  • Atenção aos detalhes
  • Disciplina de organização: nomenclatura padronizada de arquivos, versionamento, entregas no prazo, sem retrabalho excessivo.


✏️ Como se candidatar:

Preencha o formulário. Na sua aplicação ficará claro que você:

  • Domina IA no fluxo de vídeo (Sora, Runway, Veo, ElevenLabs, etc.).
  • Entrega rápido sem perder qualidade.


Valorizamos cada candidatura e revisaremos cuidadosamente todas as informações enviadas. Se sua candidatura atender aos critérios, entraremos em contato dentro de até 15 dias para informar sobre as próximas etapas do processo seletivo.

title: BIM Modeler
description:
BIM Modeler – Fire Protection / Sprinkler Systems (US Projects) | Revit MEP | 100% Remote LATAM

100% REMOTE OPPORTUNITY FOR LATAM AEC PROFESSIONALS!

Work directly with leading US-based engineering & construction firms.


Competitive Pay in USD | Full-Time (NY Schedule) | 100% Remote (Brazil)


We are hiring a BIM Modeler / Specialist focused on Fire Protection & Sprinkler Systems to join the design team of one of our U.S.-based construction clients in New York.

In this role, you will work directly with the client’s engineering team to develop detailed fire sprinkler shop drawings, build 3D models using Revit MEP and AutoSprink, and ensure full compliance with NFPA standards. This is an ideal position for Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineers with hands-on experience in fire protection design (RCI/PCI) and BIM coordination.


What We Offer

  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in LATAM directly for a U.S. client.
  • USD Compensation: Competitive rate with direct international payment.
  • Full-Time: Monday–Friday (New York / EST Schedule).
  • 18 PTO Days: Flexible paid time off for personal use.
  • Professional Growth: Direct exposure to U.S. building codes, NFPA standards, and advanced BIM workflows.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop detailed 3D models and construction-ready shop drawings using Revit MEP and AutoSprink .
  • Design, model, and coordinate fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems for commercial and residential U.S. projects.
  • Apply NFPA standards (particularly NFPA 13, 14 & 20) to develop fully compliant, constructible designs.
  • Perform clash detection and spatial coordination with Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural disciplines using Navisworks .
  • Proactively review plans to identify design conflicts and develop practical engineering solutions before construction.
  • Conduct QA/QC reviews to eliminate modeling errors and maintain organized project documentation/revisions.


What You’ll Bring

  • English Level: Advanced Technical & Conversational English (B2+ / C1).
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in fire protection design, fire sprinkler modeling, or RCI/PCI systems.
  • Core Software: Expert proficiency in Revit MEP (mandatory); strong experience with AutoSprink is highly preferred.
  • US Standards: Deep knowledge of NFPA standards (NFPA 13) and U.S. fire protection practices.
  • Education: Degree in Mechanical, Civil, Sanitary, or Fire Protection Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent practical design experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong technical background with high attention to detail and ability to work independently.


Tools & Key Skills

  • Tools: Revit MEP • AutoSprink • Navisworks • AutoCAD
  • Technical Areas: Fire Sprinkler Design • Fire Protection Systems • RCI / PCI • NFPA 13 • BIM Modeling • MEP Coordination • Shop Drawings • Clash Detection

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.

title: Email Marketing Specialist
description:
Email Marketing Specialist (Design Skill Required)


Work Schedule: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week) | Flexible working time zone.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time / Long-Term Contract


Company Overview

Our client’s company is a founder-led venture studio specializing in scaling health and wellness brands , they are hiring an experienced Email Marketing Specialist to lead lifecycle marketing across multiple brands.


The studio works closely with founders from product inception through global expansion , providing hands-on support across brand development, e-commerce, marketing, and growth strategy. Their team partners with wellness brands to build high-performing marketing systems designed for long-term scalability.


Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Email Marketing Specialist who can take ownership of email strategy across multiple e-commerce brands while managing a small team responsible for execution.


This role requires someone who is both strategic and operational — capable of planning lifecycle marketing strategies, optimizing revenue-driving flows, managing campaign calendars, and ensuring all emails meet high standards of performance and quality.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage email marketing strategy across multiple e-commerce brands
  • Build and optimize lifecycle flows (Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase, Replenishment, Win-back)
  • Plan and manage weekly campaign calendars
  • Oversee a small team responsible for email design, copy, and execution
  • Analyze campaign and flow performance to improve revenue
  • Design or edit email templates and visual assets using Figma or similar tools, ensuring brand consistency across campaigns
  • Run A/B tests and optimize segmentation and targeting
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to execute campaigns and maintain high-quality standards.


Requirements

  • +5 years managing email marketing for e-commerce brands
  • Proven experience managing multiple brands or accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar email marketing platforms
  • Working knowledge of Figma or similar design tools to create or edit email templates and visual assets
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing and automated flows
  • Experience managing or coordinating designers, copywriters, or marketing contractors
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Ability to manage campaign calendars and prioritize multiple projects
  • Experience working with high-growth consumer brands
  • Understanding of SMS marketing strategies
  • Advanced knowledge of segmentation and personalization
  • Experience scaling email revenue as a major channel for e-commerce brands


The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Is both strategic and detail-oriented
  • Has a strong understanding of e-commerce lifecycle marketing
  • Can manage both execution and team leadership
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments managing multiple brands
  • Is highly data-driven and focused on revenue growth

title: Payroll Project Lead | FIXED TERM: 12 MONTHS
description:
Kenvue is currently recruiting for a:

Payroll Project Lead | FIXED TERM: 12 MONTHS

What we do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated.  We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role reports to:

Payroll GPO Director

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

This position will support the Payroll GPO Organization within the region in scope.

Resource is responsible to be the trusted advisor to the service delivery organization, understanding their needs, translating them into business cases and overseeing the execution of projects for the existing solution landscape. This role will also manage the stabilization, anchoring and adoption of the new global solution for the deployed countries identifying potential process improvements and

opportunities in the solution and managing the relationship between the GPO Organization, the Payroll service delivery organization, the new Payroll vendor, IT and other stake holders.

This position will:

  • Partner with local country teams as well as the business architecture leads in process improvement and implementation strategies for the payroll teams relating to Salesforce, Workday, ADP, SAPtime, eTime and other strategic tools and Third-Party Vendors (TPV). Takes direction and participates as a part of the payroll global solutions organization.
  • Partner with countries within the region and Global cross functional teams to support project requirements based on these key initiatives and strategies. Interacts as regional responsible person towards the global process on budget requests and project reporting
  • Ensure the successful adoption and stabilization of the new solution by the service delivery organization and IT teams.
  • Create regional roadmaps and offer support to the country payroll teams.
  • Understand the Payroll business process, how the solutions fulfills those requirements and identify any improvement opportunity leveraging on emerging technologies, market experience and intelligent automation.

Other key expectations:

  • Innovation – Maintain a continual focus on opportunities to innovate, independently research new processes leveraging strategic technologies.
  • Project Leadership – Create detailed project plans, understand multiple project methodologies including waterfall and agile, manage project’s tasks and efforts including in all milestones, resources, finances, and status reporting.
  • Contractor Management – Manage allocated contractor resources and confirm communication of tasks and monitor and manage performance. Partner with Third Party Vendors to deliver solutions on budget and on time.
  • Technology Expertise – Not only understand emerging technologies empowering abilities to execute more efficiently, but train and research to demonstrate an expertise in these technologies.
  • Metric Reporting – Research industry best practice KPI’s and benchmarks. Create and present best in class dashboards depicting regional initiatives, strategies, and challenges.
  • Roadmap Strategy – Understand the region’s policies and regulations to manage intake for preparing long and short-term regional initiative roadmaps.
  • Global and Regional Interaction – This position will focus on 100% international interaction for the countries within region and other stakeholders globally.

As a senior-level contributor and subject matter expert, position holder is expected to perform tasks related to project management and oversight as well as providing status and analysis. Contribute to the identification, development, implementation, and communication of optimization of practices, policies, and/or procedures. Required to work independently and may assist in specialized assignments.

Ensure that deliverables meet or exceed individual objectives, adhere to payroll goals and align with service center compliance strategies.
 

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in Payroll Operations, Payroll Transformation, Payroll Technology, HR Systems, or related functions.
  • Proven experience managing complex regional or global projects, including both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of payroll processes, controls, compliance requirements, and service delivery models.
  • Hands-on experience working with payroll and HR technology platforms such as Workday, ADP, Salesforce, SAP Time, eTime, or similar solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technology-enabled solutions and process improvements.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with experience collaborating across global, regional, and local organizations.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, consultants, and external service providers.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret metrics and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage audiences at multiple organizational levels.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Spanish, with experience working in highly international and cross-cultural teams.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Role reports to:

Lead Financial Analyst

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

This position will play a critical role in managing Neutrogena’s (NTG) marketing spend forecasting, financial planning, actuals reporting, and business performance analysis. This role partners closely with Marketing, Media, Sales, and Finance leadership to deliver accurate forecasts, provide actionable business insights, identify risks and opportunities, and support strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen, analytical rigor, and business partnership skills to influence outcomes and drive continuous process improvement within a matrixed environment. This role reports into the Lead Financial Analyst supporting NTG Cleansing/Acne, Hair, and Body Categories.

Responsibilities (including, but not limited to):

Marketing Spend Forecasting & Financial Consolidations

  • Own and maintain the Total Neutrogena BME (Brand Marketing Expense) tracker, ensuring accuracy and completeness across all reporting cycles.
  • Lead monthly forecasting, annual planning, and OneStream submissions for the Neutrogena portfolio.
  • Manage centrally held expenses, including media, allocations, and agency fees, while communicating updates to business partners and finance team.
  • Ensure accurate integration of SAP actuals, forecast updates, account mappings, and structural or methodology changes.
  • Partner monthly with Marketing and Media teams to align on budget estimates and spending expectations.
  • Analyze month-over-month forecast changes and proactively identify risks and opportunities impacting full-year performance.

Actuals Management & Financial Reporting

  • Oversee BME spend actuals reporting and validation processes.
  • Monitor open purchase orders and partner with stakeholders to ensure timely review and spend visibility.
  • Validate accruals through analysis of forecast versus actual activity and investigate potential discrepancies.
  • Ensure spend is accurately recorded within appropriate accounts and profit centers, coordinating reclasses as needed.
  • Partner with Controllership to ensure actuals are complete, accurate, and fully reconciled.
  • Provide clear explanations of spending variances, business drivers, and emerging financial risks and opportunities.

Category Finance & Commercial Partnership

  • Support assigned categories through the end-to-end Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.
  • Partner with Marketing, Demand, and Customer Strategy teams to develop forecasts and evaluate commercial opportunities and risks.
  • Communicate key business drivers, forecast changes, and financial implications to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Prepare monthly close commentary and performance analysis, translating financial results into actionable insights.
  • Develop a deep understanding of category performance and serve as a trusted business partner beyond financial reporting.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and enhance forecasting and reporting processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making effectiveness.
  • Support ad hoc analyses, strategic projects, and other responsibilities as assigned.

What we are looking for

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration
  • Solid experience in Finance and/or Accounting role
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required. This role is highly stakeholder-facing and involves regular interaction with U.S. business partners, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in FP&A, commercial finance, brand finance, or related analytical roles

Nice to Have:

  • Consumer Packaged Goods experience is highly desirable
  • Professional accounting designation (CA, CMA, CGA, CPA) is an asset

Knowledge & Technical Competency Requirements:

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial reporting tools
  • Experience with financial systems such as SAP and OneStream preferred
  • Demonstrated track-record in influencing business partners with fact-based data
  • Demonstrated strong analytical skills and application of technical accounting knowledge, including knowledge of financial statements, margin analysis, cost optimization, etc.
  • Proven ability to work through ambiguity and manage change effectively
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to work effectively as part of a team

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

We are looking for a Project Lead, External Manufacturing Procurement to join our Procurement organization and support our External Manufacturing (EM) network.

Acting as the central point of coordination, you will partner closely with Procurement teams, Finance, Supply Chain, and business stakeholders to ensure successful project execution, deliver cost optimization initiatives, and support the financial management of the External Manufacturing organization.

This position offers a unique opportunity to combine project management, financial analysis, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced global environment.

  • Drive project governance, organize cross-functional meetings, monitor milestones, and provide regular status updates to leadership and stakeholders.

  • Support the qualification and onboarding of new external manufacturing partners to improve business competitiveness and supply flexibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.

  • Strong financial acumen and ability to analyze business and financial performance indicators.

  • Advanced Excel skills and strong capability to manage data-driven analyses and reporting.
